definition_zh: 减少；缩小；降低；使陷入（某种状态）；把复杂之物归结为；约分；收汁；还原；复位
definition_en: to make something smaller or lower, to bring it into a simpler form or a worse state, and in chemistry to add electrons to it
core_image: 一口宽锅里汤汁翻滚，水汽不断散走，最后只剩薄薄一层浓汁挂在锅底
scene: 厨师把一大锅汤留在小火上慢慢收，水分一点点走掉，最后只剩能挂勺的浓汁。Long simmering will reduce the sauce to a thick glaze.
sceneCN: 这里 reduce 指通过加热让液体变少变浓（第 6 个义项：烹调收汁，把汤汁熬到更少的量）；句意：长时间小火慢熬会把酱汁收成浓稠的亮汁。图中可辨识物件：宽口锅、上升的水汽、木勺、挂勺的浓汁。

pos.zh: 减少；缩小；降低；把……归结为；使陷入
减少；缩小；变浓；（化学）被还原

derivatives.zh: 由 reduce 加动作名词词尾构成，义为「减少；还原」
由 reduce 加已然词尾构成，义为「已减少的；已还原的」
由 reduce 加进行词尾构成，义为「有还原能力的」
由 reduce 加「能够被……的」后缀构成，义为「可减少的；可约分的」
由 reduce 加施动词尾构成，义为「还原剂；缩小装置」

senses.title: Make smaller in size or amount
senses.titleCN: 在大小或数量上使之变小
senses.definition: to make something smaller, fewer or less in amount
senses.definitionCN: 使某物在体积、数量或总量上变小变少
senses.example: Insulation reduces heat loss through the walls.
senses.exampleCN: 保温层减少了穿墙而走的热量。
senses.why: The core gesture is bringing something down; the modern everyday sense simply applies that downward motion to quantity and size.
senses.whyCN: 核心动作是「把某物带下来」；现代日常义只是把这个向下的动作用在数量与大小上。

senses.title: Lower a price, rate or level
senses.definition: to bring a price, rate, speed or level down to a lower figure
senses.definitionCN: 把价格、比率、速度或水平降到一个更低的数值
senses.example: The store reduced prices by a fifth before the holiday.
senses.exampleCN: 节前商店把价格降了五分之一。
senses.why: Prices and rates are quantities on a scale, so the same downward gesture is read as a movement along that scale.
senses.whyCN: 价格与比率是尺度上的量，因此同一个向下动作被读作沿尺度向下移动。

senses.title: Bring a problem to a simpler form
senses.titleCN: 把问题归结为更简单的形式
senses.definition: to restate a complicated thing as a simpler one that explains it
senses.definitionCN: 把复杂之事重新表述为能解释它的更简单之事
senses.example: The authors reduce the argument to a single question.
senses.exampleCN: 作者把这个论证归结为一个问题。
senses.why: A simpler form carries the same content in fewer parts, so reduction here means stripping away what can be dropped.
senses.whyCN: 更简单的形式用更少的部件承载同样的内容，因此这里的「减」指剥掉可以舍去的部分。

senses.title: Force into a worse condition
senses.definition: to bring someone or something into a lower or worse state, often with 'to'
senses.definitionCN: 把某人或某物带到更低、更糟的状态，常与表示「到」的介词连用
senses.example: The flood reduced the village to a few broken walls.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水使村庄只剩几堵断墙。
senses.why: The downward movement can be read as loss of standing, so the verb also describes being brought low rather than made smaller.
senses.whyCN: 向下的移动也可以读作地位的丧失，于是这个动词也描述「被压低」，而不是「被缩小」。

senses.title: Simplify a fraction in arithmetic
senses.definition: to divide the top and bottom of a fraction by a common number so that the value stays the same but the figures get smaller
senses.definitionCN: 用公因数同时除分子与分母，使数值不变而数字变小
senses.example: Students reduce the fraction before adding it to another.
senses.exampleCN: 学生先把分数约分，再与另一个分数相加。
senses.why: Arithmetic keeps the value while shrinking the written figures, which is the clearest small-scale model of the whole word.
senses.whyCN: 算术让数值保持不变而让写出的数字变小，这是整个词最小尺度、也最清晰的模型。

senses.title: Boil a liquid down
senses.definition: to cook a liquid until it thickens and its volume falls
senses.definitionCN: 加热液体使其变稠、体积减少
senses.example: Long simmering will reduce the sauce to a thick glaze.
senses.exampleCN: 长时间小火慢熬会把酱汁收成浓稠的亮汁。
senses.why: Cooking turns the abstract downward movement into something visible: steam leaves and what remains is denser.
senses.whyCN: 烹调把这个抽象的向下运动变成可见之事：水汽走掉，剩下的更浓。

senses.title: Add electrons in chemistry
senses.definition: to add electrons to an atom, ion or molecule, or to remove oxygen from it
senses.definitionCN: 给原子、离子或分子加上电子，或从中去掉氧
senses.example: Carbon can reduce the metal oxide to the metal.
senses.exampleCN: 碳能把金属氧化物还原成金属。
senses.why: The chemical sense came from the older notion of bringing a substance back to a simpler state: the ore returns to bare metal.
senses.whyCN: 化学义来自更早的「把物质带回更简单的状态」：矿石退回为纯金属。

senses.title: Put a bone or joint back in place
senses.definition: to restore a displaced bone or joint to its proper position
senses.definitionCN: 把错位的骨头或关节恢复到正确位置
senses.example: The doctor reduced the shoulder and strapped the arm.
senses.exampleCN: 医生使肩关节复位，并把手臂固定好。
senses.why: Medicine uses the original 'bring back' reading literally: the part is led back to where it belongs.
senses.whyCN: 医学把最初「带回」的读法用在字面上：那个部位被领回原位。

senses.title: Sum up raw data
senses.titleCN: 把原始数据归纳成摘要
senses.definition: to turn a set of measurements into a few summary figures
senses.definitionCN: 把一组测量值变成少数几个汇总数字
senses.example: The software reduces thousands of readings to a mean and a range.
senses.exampleCN: 软件把上千个读数归纳成一个均值与一个范围。
senses.why: Statistics repeats the simplifying gesture: many pieces become one figure that is easier to hold.
senses.whyCN: 统计学重复了那个简化动作：许多碎片变成一个更易把握的数字。

intro.en: Reduce comes from Latin reducere, 'to lead back', built on re- 'back' and ducere 'to lead'. English shortened the sense to 'bring down' and later added technical uses. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: reduce 来自拉丁 reducere「领回」，由 re-「向后」与 ducere「引领」构成；英语把词义收窄到「使降低」，之后又长出各种专门用法。年代为约数。

items.en: Ducere meant 'to lead or draw along', the root behind duke, duct and conduct; the idea is direction rather than shrinking.
items.cn: ducere 意为「引领、牵引」，是 duke、duct、conduct 等词背后的词根；其核心是方向，而不是缩小。

items.en: Re- 'back' plus ducere produced reducere, 'to lead back, bring back, restore', as one brings a traveller or a troop home.
items.cn: re-「向后」加 ducere 构成 reducere「领回、带回、恢复」，如同把旅人或队伍带回家。

items.en: English took the word through Old French, first in the senses of bringing back, restoring and leading a person to a place.
items.cn: 英语经古法语引入该词，最初指带回、恢复、把人领到某处。

items.en: From the sixteenth century the verb increasingly meant bringing something to a lower figure or condition, and that reading now dominates ordinary use.
items.cn: 从 16 世纪起，这个动词越来越多地指把某物带到更低的数值或状态，这一读法如今在日常用法中占主导。

items.en: Cooking added the simmering sense, arithmetic the simplifying of fractions, and medicine the restoring of a joint; chemistry adopted 'reduce' for the removal of oxygen, later generalised to the gain of electrons.
items.cn: 烹调加上收汁义，算术加上约分义，医学加上关节复位义；化学用这个词指去掉氧，后来又一般化为「获得电子」。

items.en: First date uncertain for the sense shift: the date at which the 'lessen' sense overtook the older 'bring back' sense is inferred from citation records, not a fixed event.
items.cn: 义项转变的首见年代不确定：表示「减少」的义项何时压过更早的「带回」义，是根据文献记录作出的推断，并非某一个确定事件。

note.en: The first group shares the same Latin root and is constantly confused; the second group holds other words for making something less.
note.cn: 第一组共享同一拉丁词根，极易混淆；第二组是其他表示「使变少」的词。

entries.tag: the noun of the same verb
entries.definition: The act or result of reducing, including the chemical gain of electrons; it names the event, not the action of doing it.
entries.definitionCN: 减少的动作或结果，也包括化学上的获得电子；它命名事件，而非执行动作。

entries.definition: Built on de- 'down from' plus ducere: to draw a conclusion out of given premises, which is reasoning, not shrinking.
entries.definitionCN: 由 de-「从……向下」加 ducere 构成：从给定前提出结论，属推理，不属缩小。

entries.definition: In- 'into' plus ducere: to lead someone into a state or to bring about an effect, with no sense of lessening.
entries.definitionCN: in-「进入」加 ducere：把某人引入某种状态或促成某结果，与「变少」无关。

entries.definition: Pro- 'forward' plus ducere: to bring something out into existence; the root is shared but the direction is opposite.
entries.definitionCN: pro-「向前」加 ducere：把某物带出来使其存在；词根相同但方向相反。

entries.definition: To become or make less in number or size; it states the change of amount without the idea of simplifying or restoring.
entries.definitionCN: 在数量或大小上变少或使之变少；它只说量的变化，不含简化或恢复之意。

entries.definition: To move something down in height, level or rank; it suits a position on a scale better than a bulk of material.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物在高度、水平或等级上往下移；它更适合尺度上的位置，而非成堆的物质。

entries.definition: To remove a portion, especially of cost, text or supply; it stresses the removal rather than the resulting smallness.
entries.definitionCN: 去掉一部分，尤指费用、文字或供应；它强调移除，而非变小后的结果。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: re- 'back' plus ducere 'lead': the oldest picture is leading something back home.
normal.cn: re-「向后」加 ducere「引领」：最早的画面是把某物领回家。

normal.en: The family runs reduce, reduction, reduced, reducing, reducible, reducer.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 reduce、reduction、reduced、reducing、reducible、reducer。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the modern sense: reduce costs, reduce the risk, reduce emissions.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出现代义：降低成本、降低风险、减少排放。

normal.en: The same root leads in deduce, induce and produce, each with a different direction.
normal.cn: 同一词根也出现在 deduce、induce 与 produce 中，各自的方向不同。

normal.en: Chemistry keeps an old picture: ore is led back to bare metal.
normal.cn: 化学保留了一个旧画面：矿石被领回成纯金属。

abstract.en: Picture a wide pot of soup losing its steam until only a spoonful of glaze is left.
abstract.cn: 想象一大锅汤不断散走水汽，最后只剩一勺浓汁。

abstract.en: Picture a long report folded again and again until one small square remains.
abstract.cn: 想象一份长报告被反复对折，最后只剩一个小方块。

abstract.en: Picture a scattered crowd walking back through one gate until the field is empty.
abstract.cn: 想象散开的人群从一道门走回，最后场地空了。

examples.en: Better lamps reduce the electricity bill in winter.
examples.cn: 更好的灯具能降低冬季电费。

examples.en: The committee reduced the proposal to three short points.
examples.cn: 委员会把提案归结为三条短要点。

examples.en: Hydrogen can reduce the oxide at high temperature.
examples.cn: 氢在高温下能还原这种氧化物。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（再）+ duce（引导）」——把数量往回领，就是减少

root: 拉丁 reducere「领回、带回」= re-（向后）+ ducere「引领」；英语先取「带回、恢复」义，后转为「使降低、减少」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one downward or backward gesture: quantity falls, price falls, a problem is simplified, a person is brought low, a fraction shrinks, a sauce thickens, an ore returns to metal, a joint returns to place, and data is folded into a summary.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项围绕同一个向下或向回的动作：数量下降、价格下降、问题被简化、人被压低、分数变小、酱汁变浓、矿石退回金属、关节回到原位、数据被折成摘要。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wide pot of sauce simmering down to a spoonful of thick glaze.
core.cn: 核心意象：一口宽锅里的酱汁慢慢收成一勺浓汁。

branches.en: DOWN THE SCALE: whatever is counted or priced moves to a smaller figure, from heat loss to holiday prices.
branches.cn: 沿尺度向下：凡可计数或标价之物都移向更小的数字，从热损失到节日价格。

branches.en: FEWER PARTS: an argument or a pile of readings is restated in a form that can be held at once.
branches.cn: 更少的部件：论证或一堆读数被重新表述成可以一次握住的形式。

branches.en: LED TO A PLACE: a village is led down to rubble, and a shoulder is led back into its socket.
branches.cn: 被领到某处：村庄被带到只剩瓦砾，肩关节被领回关节窝。

branches.en: SHRINKING THE WRITTEN OR THE LIQUID: a fraction loses common factors, a sauce loses water.
branches.cn: 缩小写下的或流动的：分数失去公因数，酱汁失去水分。

branches.en: THE ORE RETURNS: chemistry keeps the oldest picture and calls the gain of electrons a leading back.
branches.cn: 矿石退回：化学保留最古老的画面，把获得电子称为「领回」。

intro.en: Reduce is a Latin prefix plus a Latin verb root, and both parts are unusually productive in English.
intro.cn: reduce 由一个拉丁前缀加一个拉丁动词词根构成，这两部分在英语里都异常能产。

latinIntro.en: Latin ducere gives duct, conduct, induce, produce and deduce, while re- recur in return, remain and reflect.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ducere 衍生 duct、conduct、induce、produce 与 deduce，而 re- 也反复出现在 return、remain 与 reflect 中。

items.meaning: to lead back; to bring down

definition_zh: 减少；削减；降低；还原；（数学）约简；（烹饪）收汁
definition_en: the act of making something smaller or simpler, or the amount by which it is made smaller
core_image: 一块厚布被两边慢慢拉紧，最后缩成一小片
scene: 家里换了新锅炉之后，暖气费账单明显薄了一截。The new boiler led to a twenty percent reduction in fuel use.
sceneCN: 这里 reduction 指「用量下降的幅度」（第 1 个义项：数量或程度变小）；句意：新锅炉使燃料用量减少了百分之二十。图中可辨识物件：旧锅炉、新锅炉、下降箭头、用量表。

senses.title: A decrease in amount
senses.titleCN: 数量减少：总量或程度变小
senses.definition: the act or result of making an amount, rate or level smaller
senses.definitionCN: 使数量、比率或水平变小的动作或结果
senses.example: The new boiler led to a twenty percent reduction in fuel use.
senses.exampleCN: 新锅炉使燃料用量减少了百分之二十。
senses.why: Reduction comes from Latin reducere 'to lead back'; the modern 'make smaller' sense grew from leading something down to a lower level.
senses.whyCN: reduction 出自拉丁 reducere「带回」；现代「使变小」义由「把某物带到更低水平」发展而来。

senses.title: A price cut
senses.definition: a lowering of price, often offered as a discount
senses.definitionCN: 价格的调低，常作为折扣给出
senses.example: The store advertised a fifty-dollar reduction on the jacket.
senses.exampleCN: 商店宣传这件夹克降价五十美元。
senses.why: Commerce applies the physical image of lowering to money: the price is brought down, and the amount is called a reduction.
senses.whyCN: 商业把「降低」的物理意象用于金钱：价格被带下来，降下的数额就叫 reduction。

senses.title: Chemical reduction
senses.titleCN: 化学还原：物质得到电子
senses.definition: in chemistry, the process in which a substance gains electrons and its oxidation state falls
senses.definitionCN: 化学中物质获得电子、氧化态降低的过程
senses.example: Iron ore is turned into metal by chemical reduction in a furnace.
senses.exampleCN: 铁矿石在炉中经化学还原变成金属。
senses.why: Chemists kept the 'lowering' idea: the oxidation number is brought down as electrons are added, so the reaction is a reduction.
senses.whyCN: 化学家保留了「降低」的观念：加入电子后氧化数被带低，因此该反应称为还原。

senses.title: Mathematical simplification
senses.titleCN: 数学约简：把式子化到更简形式
senses.definition: in mathematics, the rewriting of an expression or problem into a simpler equivalent form
senses.definitionCN: 数学中把表达式或问题改写为更简单的等价形式
senses.example: Reduction of the fraction 18/24 gives 3/4.
senses.exampleCN: 把分数 18/24 约简得到 3/4。
senses.why: The 'lead back' sense survives here: a complex expression is led back to its simplest equivalent.
senses.whyCN: 「带回」义在此留存：复杂表达式被带回其最简单的等价形式。

senses.title: Cooking down a sauce
senses.titleCN: 烹煮收汁：水分蒸发使汤汁变浓
senses.definition: in cooking, the evaporation of liquid so that a sauce becomes thicker and more concentrated
senses.definitionCN: 烹饪中液体蒸发、使酱汁变稠变浓的过程
senses.example: A slow reduction concentrates the flavour of the stock.
senses.exampleCN: 慢火收汁使高汤的味道更浓缩。
senses.why: The kitchen borrows the volume sense literally: the liquid is reduced in quantity while the flavour remains.
senses.whyCN: 厨房直接借用了体积义：液体数量变少，而风味保留。

senses.title: Lowering in rank
senses.titleCN: 降级：职位或地位被调低
senses.definition: the act of moving someone to a lower rank, position or status
senses.definitionCN: 把某人调到更低职级、职位或地位的行为
senses.example: His reduction from captain to private was announced at roll call.
senses.exampleCN: 点名列队时宣布他从上尉降为列兵。
senses.why: This sense is the oldest direction of ducere: a person is led back down the hierarchy.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项最贴近 ducere 的原始方向：人被沿着等级序列带回下方。

senses.title: Data reduction
senses.titleCN: 数据简化：把原始数据压缩成可用摘要
senses.definition: the process of summarizing or simplifying large sets of raw data into usable measures
senses.definitionCN: 把大量原始数据汇总或简化为可用指标的过程
senses.example: Data reduction turned thousands of sensor readings into one daily average.
senses.exampleCN: 数据简化把数千条传感器读数变成一个日均值。
senses.why: The word is applied to information rather than matter: detail is brought down to a manageable summary.
senses.whyCN: 该词被用于信息而非物质：细节被压到可处理的摘要层级。

senses.title: Reductio ad absurdum
senses.titleCN: 归谬：把命题推到荒谬以反驳它
senses.definition: in logic, the method of disproving a claim by showing that its consequences are absurd
senses.definitionCN: 逻辑中通过显示某主张的推论荒谬来反驳它的方法
senses.example: The proof proceeds by reduction to absurdity.
senses.exampleCN: 该证明通过归谬法推进。
senses.why: The Latin phrase reductio ad absurdum means 'a leading back to the absurd': the argument leads the claim back to a contradiction.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁短语 reductio ad absurdum 意为「带回到荒谬」：论证把该主张带回矛盾之处。

intro.en: Reduction comes from Latin reductio, the noun of action from reducere 'to lead back'. The English word first meant a bringing back, and later narrowed toward 'making smaller'.
intro.cn: reduction 出自拉丁 reductio，即 reducere「带回」的动作名词。英语词最初意为「带回」，后来收窄为「使变小」。

items.en: Latin ducere meant 'to lead, draw, conduct'. Its family includes conduct, produce, induce, introduce and reduce.
items.cn: 拉丁 ducere 意为「引导、拉、带领」，其词族包括 conduct、produce、induce、introduce、reduce。

items.en: Reducere joined re- 'back' to ducere, meaning 'to lead back, bring back'. It could be used for troops, for a price, or for a written argument.
items.cn: reducere 把 re-「回」加到 ducere，意为「带回、领回」，可用于军队、价格或书面论证。

items.en: The Latin action noun reductio named the act of leading back. In logic, reductio ad absurdum named a proof that leads a claim back to contradiction.
items.cn: 拉丁动作名词 reductio 指「带回」的行为。逻辑中的 reductio ad absurdum 指把主张带回到矛盾的证明。

items.en: English reduction entered in the sixteenth century, first as a bringing back or restoration, then as a lowering or diminishing.
items.cn: 英语 reduction 于 16 世纪进入，最初指带回或恢复，后指降低或减少。

items.en: Chemistry, mathematics, cooking and data processing each fixed a specialized sense of the lowering or simplifying action.
items.cn: 化学、数学、烹饪与数据处理各自固定了「降低」或「简化」动作的专门义项。

items.en: The exact first English citation is uncertain, and the deeper origin of Latin ducere is generally discussed only as a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词根）：英语最早书证确切年代存疑；拉丁 ducere 的更深来源通常只能作为重构来讨论。

note.en: The first group separates the reduce family from near-looking forms; the second gives near-synonyms that stress amount, cut or simplification.
note.cn: 第一组区分 reduce 词族与形近形式；第二组给出强调数量、削减或简化的近义词。

entries.definition: To make smaller or simpler; reduction is the act or the resulting amount.
entries.definitionCN: 指使变小或变简单；reduction 是动作或由此得到的量。

entries.definition: Describing something that simplifies, often with disapproval. It is not the noun for a cut.
entries.definitionCN: 形容简化的，常带贬义；不是表示「削减量」的名词。

entries.definition: The theory that complex things can be explained by simpler parts. It is not a decrease in quantity.
entries.definitionCN: 指复杂事物可由更简单部分解释的理论，并非数量减少。

entries.definition: Logical inference from general to specific, from Latin deducere 'lead away'. The prefix changes the direction.
entries.definitionCN: 指从一般到具体的逻辑推理，出自拉丁 deducere「带走」；前缀改变了方向。

entries.definition: A general fall in amount. Reduction often implies a deliberate act by someone.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指数量下降；reduction 常暗示有人有意采取行动。

entries.definition: An often sudden or politically decided lowering, especially of budgets or staff. It is more informal than reduction.
entries.definitionCN: 常指突然或政治上决定的削减，尤指预算或人员，比 reduction 更口语。

entries.definition: A gradual worsening or falling off. It usually happens over time rather than by a single act.
entries.definitionCN: 指逐渐恶化或下降，通常随时间发生，而非由单一行动造成。

entries.definition: The act of making something easier to understand. It stresses clarity, not size.
entries.definitionCN: 指使某物更易理解，强调清晰而非规模。

entries.definition: A specific lowering of price. It overlaps sense 2 but names the commercial offer, not the general act.
entries.definitionCN: 特指价格下调，与第 2 个义项重叠，但命名的是商业优惠而非一般行为。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: re- 'back' + ducere 'lead' + -tion: leading something back down.
normal.cn: re-「回」+ ducere「引导」+ -tion：把某物带回低处。

normal.en: The family runs reduce, reductive, reducer, reductionism, irreducible.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 reduce、reductive、reducer、reductionism、irreducible。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: cost reduction, emission reduction, data reduction, reduction to absurdity.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：成本削减、减排、数据简化、归谬法。

normal.en: Chemistry says reduction when electrons are gained and the oxidation number falls.
normal.cn: 化学中，得到电子、氧化数下降就叫还原。

normal.en: deduction leads away; reduction leads back. The prefix decides the direction.
normal.cn: deduction 带走，reduction 带回；前缀决定方向。

abstract.en: Picture a thick cloth pulled tight from both sides until it shrinks to a small patch.
abstract.cn: 想象一块厚布被两边拉紧，最后缩成一小片。

abstract.en: Picture a stack of papers whittled down to a single summary card.
abstract.cn: 想象一摞文件被削成一张摘要卡。

abstract.en: Picture a sauce simmering until the surface drops and the colour deepens.
abstract.cn: 想象酱汁慢煮到液面下降、颜色加深。

examples.en: The policy aims at a thirty percent reduction in plastic waste by 2030.
examples.cn: 该政策目标是到 2030 年将塑料废物减少三成。

examples.en: Reduction of the oxide with carbon yields iron and carbon dioxide.
examples.cn: 用碳还原氧化物会生成铁和二氧化碳。

examples.en: After data reduction, the team kept only the four most stable variables.
examples.cn: 经过数据简化，团队只保留四个最稳定的变量。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（回）+ duct（引导）」——把数量往回带 → reduction 减少、削减

root: 拉丁 ducere「引导」→ reducere「带回、领回」→ reductio「带回」；英语 reduction。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all lower something: an amount, a price, an oxidation state, an expression, a sauce, a rank, a data set, or a claim driven back into contradiction.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在「把某物带低」：数量、价格、氧化态、表达式、酱汁、职级、数据集，或被带回矛盾的命题。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thick cloth drawn tight until it shrinks to a patch.
core.cn: 核心意象：厚布被拉紧，缩成一小片。

branches.en: AMOUNT AND PRICE: something is brought down, whether a quantity or a tag.
branches.cn: 数量与价格：被带低的东西，或是一个量，或是一个标价。

branches.en: CHEMISTRY: electrons are added and the oxidation number falls.
branches.cn: 化学：加入电子，氧化数下降。

branches.en: SIMPLIFICATION: expressions and raw data are led back to manageable forms.
branches.cn: 简化：表达式与原始数据被带回可处理的形式。

branches.en: KITCHEN: liquid volume falls while flavour concentrates.
branches.cn: 厨房：液体体积下降，风味浓缩。

branches.en: RANK AND LOGIC: a person is led down the hierarchy, or a claim is led back to absurdity.
branches.cn: 职级与逻辑：人沿等级被带下，或主张被带回到荒谬。

intro.en: Reduction is a Latin action noun in -tio laid onto the verb reducere, which joins 'back' to 'lead'. English keeps both the physical and the figurative directions.
intro.cn: reduction 是加在动词 reducere 上的拉丁 -tio 动作名词，该动词把「回」与「引导」结合。英语同时保留其物理与比喻方向。

latinIntro.en: The ducere family is large: conduct, produce, induce, introduce, deduce, reduce, educate and seduce all contain the 'lead' root, but each prefix sets a different direction.
latinIntro.cn: ducere 词族庞大：conduct、produce、induce、introduce、deduce、reduce、educate、seduce 都含「引导」词根，但各前缀设定不同方向。

items.meaning: a leading back; a lowering
items.meaningCN: 带回；降低
items.example: The reduction in hours improved safety.
items.exampleCN: 工时减少改善了安全状况。

items.meaning: to bring down or make smaller
items.meaningCN: 使下降或变小
items.example: The factory reduced water use by half.
items.exampleCN: 工厂把用水量减少了一半。

items.meaning: simplifying; tending to explain away
items.meaningCN: 简化的；倾向化约的
items.example: The review called the argument reductive.
items.exampleCN: 评论称该论证过于化约。

items.meaning: a device or substance that lowers something
items.meaningCN: 使某物降低的装置或物质
items.example: A pressure reducer sits before the valve.
items.exampleCN: 阀门前装有一个减压器。

items.meaning: cannot be made simpler or smaller
items.meaningCN: 不能进一步简化或缩小的
items.example: The problem is irreducible to one cause.
items.exampleCN: 这个问题无法化约为单一原因。

items.meaning: a leading away; inference
items.meaningCN: 带走；演绎推理
items.example: The deduction follows from the two premises.
items.exampleCN: 该推论由两个前提推出。

items.meaning: to lead into; to bring about
items.meaningCN: 引入；导致
items.example: Warmth induces the seeds to sprout.
items.exampleCN: 温度促使种子发芽。

items.meaning: to lead together; to carry
items.meaningCN: 共同引导；传导
items.example: Copper conducts heat well.
items.exampleCN: 铜导热良好。

definition_zh: 提及；参考；查阅；咨询；提交；转介；归功于；适用于
definition_en: to mention someone or something, to consult information, to send a person to someone else for help, or to have something as its subject
core_image: 把一件事情带回去指向它本来的源头：一根手指伸出去，指向别处的另一个人、一本书或一条记录
scene: 演讲者讲述的研究方法引起了大家的兴趣，他随后把原始报告的标题告诉了听众。The speaker referred the audience to the original research report.
sceneCN: 这里 refer 是「指引参考」（第 3 个义项：让某人去查看某处信息）；句意：演讲者指引听众去参考原始的研究报告。场景要点：讲台、投影上的参考文献页、台下举起的手。

pos.zh: 提及；指引；转介；提交；归功于
参考；查阅；指…而言；适用于

collocations.phrase: refer a patient to a specialist
collocations.zh: 把病人转介给专科医生

collocations.phrase: refer the matter to a committee

derivatives.zh: 由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「提及；参考；出处」
由拉丁语分词一词化而来，义为「裁判；推荐人」（被咨询并给出意见的人）
由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「转介；转诊」
由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「所指对象」（词语指向的东西）
由动词加形容词后缀构成，义为「可归因于…的；可提交的」

senses.title: Mention something briefly
senses.definition: to mention or speak about someone or something, often briefly or indirectly
senses.definitionCN: 提及或谈到某人某事，常为简短或间接地谈到
senses.example: In her speech she referred to her difficult early years.
senses.exampleCN: 她在演讲中提到了自己艰难的早年岁月。
senses.why: To refer is to point back at something: the finger goes out and the listener follows it to the thing pointed at.
senses.whyCN: refer 的本义是「指回去」：手指伸出去，听者顺着它走到所指之物那里。

senses.title: Name someone or something as
senses.definition: to use a particular name or description for someone or something, as in refer to someone as something
senses.definitionCN: 用某个名称或说法称呼某人某物，如 refer to someone as… 结构
senses.example: Locals still refer to him as the mayor though he retired years ago.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管他多年前已退休，当地人仍称他为市长。
senses.why: Pointing becomes naming: the pointing finger fixes on a person and attaches a label to what it touches.
senses.whyCN: 指点变成命名：指向的手指停在一个人身上，并给被指之物贴上标签。

senses.title: Send someone to a source of information
senses.definition: to direct someone to a book, document, or person where they can find information
senses.definitionCN: 让某人去某本书、某份文件或某个人那里查找信息
senses.example: The librarian referred the student to the archives on the third floor.
senses.exampleCN: 图书管理员指引那位学生去三楼的档案室查阅。
senses.why: When you cannot answer yourself, you carry the question back to its proper source — the sense keeps the Latin idea of carrying something back to its origin.
senses.whyCN: 当你自己答不上来，就把问题带回它本来的源头——这个义项保留了拉丁语「带回原处」的观念。

senses.title: Consult a source while working
senses.definition: to look at a book, list, or note in order to get information, often while doing something else
senses.definitionCN: 为获取信息而查看书、名单或笔记，常与手头的事同时进行
senses.example: During the exam we could refer to the formula sheet.
senses.exampleCN: 考试时我们可以翻看公式表。
senses.why: Here the person does the going themselves: instead of being sent to the source, the speaker travels back to it whenever needed.
senses.whyCN: 这里是自己动手：不再被派去源头，而是需要时自己随时回到源头那里。

senses.title: Pass a person or case to someone else
senses.definition: to send a person to a specialist, or a case to a court or committee, because someone else can deal with it better
senses.definitionCN: 因为他人更擅长处理，而把病人转给专科医生、把案件转给法院或委员会
senses.example: Her doctor referred her to a heart specialist.
senses.exampleCN: 医生把她转诊给心脏专科医生。
senses.why: The thing referred is physically carried back and handed over to the proper handler, whether a patient or a legal file.
senses.whyCN: 被 refer 的对象被实实在在地带回去、移交到合适的人手里——不论是一位病人还是一份案卷。

senses.title: Attribute something to a source
senses.definition: to say that something belongs to or comes from a particular cause, time, or group
senses.definitionCN: 说明某事物属于或来自某个原因、时期或类别
senses.example: The committee referred the decline in numbers to the new visa rules.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会把人数下降归因于新的签证规定。
senses.why: Carrying a fact back to its origin is exactly what attribution is: the effect is connected back to its cause.
senses.whyCN: 把一个事实带回到它的源头，正是「归因」：结果被重新连接到它的原因上。

senses.title: Have something as the subject
senses.definition: of a word, sign, or symbol, to point to the person or thing it stands for
senses.definitionCN: 指词语、符号或标志所指向的、它所代表的人或事物
senses.example: The pronoun she refers to the queen in the previous sentence.
senses.exampleCN: 代词 she 指前一句中的王后。
senses.why: Language itself points: every word is a finger that reaches out to what it means, so the word refers.
senses.whyCN: 语言本身就在指认：每个词都是一根伸向所指之物的手指，所以说这个词 refers。

senses.title: Be about a particular matter
senses.definition: of a remark or document, to concern the specific matter that has been mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 指言论或文件涉及已经提到过的特定事项
senses.example: The clause refers only to overseas income.
senses.exampleCN: 该条款只涉及海外收入。
senses.why: A text is a collection of pointing words: when all the fingers land in one place, the text is about that place.
senses.whyCN: 文本是一堆指认的词：当所有的手指都落在同一处，这份文本就是关于那个地方的。

senses.title: Send a question for decision
senses.definition: to officially send a question, complaint, or plan to an authority that will decide it
senses.definitionCN: 把问题、投诉或方案正式送交有裁决权的机构处理
senses.example: Parliament referred the bill to a joint committee.
senses.exampleCN: 议会把该法案送交联合委员会审议。
senses.why: In formal use the carrying back becomes carrying up: the matter leaves ordinary hands and is deposited where decisions are made.
senses.whyCN: 在正式用法里，「带回」变成「上呈」：事项离开普通经手人，被交放到有权决断的地方。

intro.en: Refer comes from Latin referre 'to carry back, bring back, report', from re- 'back' + ferre 'to carry, bear'. Latin referre already meant both 'point to' and 'attribute to', and English has kept the double meaning since the fifteenth century.
intro.cn: refer 来自拉丁语 referre「带回、送回、报告」，由 re-「回」加 ferre「携带」构成。拉丁语 referre 本就兼有「指向」与「归因」两义，英语自十五世纪起一直保留这个双义。

items.en: The root bher- 'to carry' underlies Latin ferre, English bear, and Sanskrit bhárati. The idea of carrying something from one place to another is the shared core.
items.cn: 词根 bher-「携带」是拉丁语 ferre、英语 bear 和梵语 bhárati 的共同来源。「把某物从一处带到另一处」是三个词共享的核心。

items.en: Referre combined re- 'back, again' with ferre 'carry': to carry something back to its source, and hence to report it, relate it, or ascribe it to something.
items.cn: referre 由 re-「回、再」加 ferre「携带」构成：把某物带回源头，由此引申出「报告、叙述、归于某物」等义。

items.en: Referen is first recorded around 1382 with the religious sense 'to attribute glory to God' — carrying something back to its giver. The general sense 'to relate to, concern' appears in the fifteenth century.
items.cn: referen 最早记录于约 1382 年，为宗教义「把荣耀归于上帝」——把某物带回其授予者。泛义「与…有关、涉及」出现于十五世纪。

items.en: The senses 'consult a source' (c. 1600), 'send a person or case onward' (17th c.), and 'point to what a word stands for' (19th c.) all grow from the same image of carrying or pointing back.
items.cn: 「查阅资料」（约 1600 年）、「转送人或案件」（17 世纪）、「指词语所指」（19 世纪）各义都从「带回或指向」这同一意象生长出来。

items.en: The spelling rule is regular: refer doubles the final r in referred, referring, referral, because the stress falls on the last syllable. Reference and referee keep the single r of the noun family.
items.cn: 拼写规则很规整：refer 在重音落在末音节时构成 referred、referring、referral 时双写 r。名词一族的 reference、referee 则保持单 r。

note.en: The first group gathers words built on the same Latin ferre with re-: they all picture something carried back or between people. The second group compares the verbs of pointing to or mentioning something.
note.cn: 第一组汇集以同一拉丁词 ferre 加 re- 构成的词：它们都画着「某物被带回或转递」的图景。第二组比较几个「指向或提及」的动词。

entries.definition: the act of mentioning, or the source consulted. It is the noun built on refer.
entries.definitionCN: 提及的行为，或查阅的出处。它是由 refer 构成的名词。

entries.definition: originally the person to whom a disputed matter is referred, now the judge of a game. It names the handler, not the act.
entries.definitionCN: 原指争议事项被提交给的人，现为比赛裁判。它命名处理者，而非动作。

entries.definition: the act of sending a patient or case to someone else. It doubles the r like the verb.
entries.definitionCN: 把病人或案件转交他人的行为。与动词一样双写 r。

entries.definition: to carry one thing before another, hence to like better. Different prefix, same ferre.
entries.definitionCN: 把一物置于另一物之前，引申为更喜欢。前缀不同，词根同为 ferre。

entries.definition: to carry across from one place or person to another. The carrying is across, not back.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物从一处或一人转到另一处或另一人。携带方向是「横过」而非「回」。

entries.definition: to speak of something briefly, without directing anyone to it. Mention names the act only; refer often adds the pointing.
entries.definitionCN: 简短谈到某事，但不指引任何人前往。mention 只命名这个动作；refer 常带指向。

entries.definition: to go to a book or expert for information. Consult stresses the seeking; refer to stresses the source you turn to.
entries.definitionCN: 向书或专家求取信息。consult 强调求取行为；refer to 强调你转向的那个出处。

entries.definition: to mention indirectly, touching on something without naming it. It is the indirect cousin of refer to.
entries.definitionCN: 间接提及，点到而不明说。它是 refer to 的间接式表亲。

entries.definition: to quote or name a source as authority. Cite fixes the exact source; refer only points the way.
entries.definitionCN: 引用或注明来源作为依据。cite 锁定确切出处；refer 只是指路。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: Latin re- 'back' + ferre 'carry', the derived nouns reference, referral and referee, and the spelling rule of doubling the r.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与真实同族词：拉丁语 re-「回」加 ferre「携带」，派生名词 reference、referral、referee，以及双写 r 的拼写规则。

normal.en: re- means back and ferre means carry: to refer is to carry the listener back to something.
normal.cn: re- 是「回」，ferre 是「携带」：refer 就是把听者带回某处。

normal.en: ferre is the same root as English bear: both picture something being carried.
normal.cn: ferre 与英语 bear 同根：两者都画着「某物被携带」的图景。

normal.en: The verb doubles its r when the stress is final: referred, referring, referral.
normal.cn: 重音在末音节时动词双写 r：referred、referring、referral。

normal.en: A referee is the one a dispute is referred to: the name keeps the whole grammar inside it.
normal.cn: referee 就是争议被 refer 给的那个人：这个词名把整个语法关系装在自身里。

normal.en: Doctors refer patients upward to specialists; readers refer downward to footnotes: the carrying back goes both ways.
normal.cn: 医生把病人向上转给专科医生；读者向下翻查脚注：「带回」是双向的。

abstract.en: Picture a hand stretched out pointing at a book on a far shelf: the gesture is the word.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手伸出去，指向远处书架上的一本书：这个手势就是这个词。

abstract.en: Every reference list is a row of fingers: each title points back to where an idea was born.
abstract.cn: 每份参考文献都是一排手指：每个书名都指回一个想法诞生的地方。

abstract.en: Refer is about direction, not detail: it tells you where to go, not what you will find.
abstract.cn: refer 的关键是指路，不是细节：它告诉你去哪，而不保证你会找到什么。

examples.en: The manager referred the complaint to the customer service team.
examples.cn: 经理把投诉转给了客服团队。

examples.en: Please refer to chapter five for the full data set.
examples.cn: 完整数据请查阅第五章。

examples.en: He often referred to his years abroad when explaining his habits.
examples.cn: 他解释自己的习惯时，常提起在国外的那些年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「锐赋」——锐赋老师答题时不直接给答案，只锐利地把你「赋」回课本那一页 → refer 指引查阅；提及（只借音，不表词源）

root: 源自拉丁语 referre「带回、送回」（re- 回 + ferre 携带），核心是「把人、话或事项带回到它本来的源头」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of refer, all from one gesture: something is carried or pointed back to a source — a person, a book, a cause, or the thing a word stands for.
sensesIntro.cn: refer 的九个义项都来自同一个手势：某物被带回或指向一个源头——一个人、一本书、一个原因，或一个词所指的事物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger stretched back toward the source of a thing.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根手指伸回去，指向某物的源头。

branches.en: SPEAKING: to mention something and to give it a name are both pointings made with words.
branches.cn: 言谈：提及某事和给某事起名称，都是用词语完成的指认。

branches.en: INFORMATION: either you are sent to the source, or you go to it yourself while working.
branches.cn: 信息：要么你被派往出处，要么你工作时自己走向出处。

branches.en: HANDING OVER: patients, cases, and bills are carried back and deposited with the proper handler.
branches.cn: 移交：病人、案件与法案被带回去，交放到合适的处理者手里。

branches.en: CAUSATION: a fact is carried back until it rests on the cause that produced it.
branches.cn: 因果：一个事实被带回，直到它落在产生它的原因上。

branches.en: MEANING: words and texts refer as fingers do — what they point at is what they are about.
branches.cn: 语义：词语与文本像手指一样指认——指向什么，就是关于什么。

intro.en: Refer shows the Latin prefix re- 'back' on the verb stem ferre 'carry'. English keeps the whole ferre family: prefer, transfer, confer, offer and suffer all carry the same verb with different prefixes.
intro.cn: refer 在动词词干 ferre「携带」上显示拉丁前缀 re-「回」。英语保留了整个 ferre 词族：prefer、transfer、confer、offer、suffer 都是同一动词配不同前缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is referre 'carry back' (re- 'back' + ferre 'carry, bear'). Ferre is one of the most productive Latin verbs: with each new prefix it builds a new English verb family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语源头是 referre「带回」（re-「回」+ ferre「携带、承载」）。ferre 是产出最高的拉丁动词之一：每换一个前缀，就生成一个新的英语动词家族。

items.meaning: to carry back to a source; to point to
items.meaningCN: 带回源头；指认（re- 回 + ferre 携带）
items.example: The article refers to several early studies.
items.exampleCN: 这篇文章提到了几项早期研究。

items.meaning: an act of referring, or a source consulted
items.meaningCN: 提及；出处（-ence 构成行为名词）
items.example: Keep a list of every reference you use.
items.exampleCN: 把你用过的每条出处都列成清单。

items.meaning: the sending of a person or case onward
items.meaningCN: 转介；转诊（-al 构成行为名词）
items.example: The clinic made an urgent referral to the hospital.
items.exampleCN: 诊所向医院发出了紧急转诊。

items.meaning: the person a matter is referred to; a judge of a game
items.meaningCN: 裁判；受托处理者（-ee 表示被交给的人）
items.example: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
items.exampleCN: 裁判鸣哨判了犯规。

items.meaning: to carry one option before another; to like better
items.meaningCN: 更喜欢；偏好（prae- 在前 + ferre 携带）
items.example: I prefer tea to coffee in the evening.
items.exampleCN: 晚上我更喜欢喝茶而不是咖啡。

items.meaning: to carry across to another place or owner
items.meaningCN: 转移；转让（trans- 横过 + ferre 携带）
items.example: He transferred to the Shanghai office last spring.
items.exampleCN: 他去年春天调到了上海办公室。

items.meaning: to bring views together in discussion; to bestow
items.meaningCN: 商议；授予（con- 一起 + ferre 携带）
items.example: The board conferred for two hours before voting.
items.exampleCN: 董事会商议了两个小时才投票。

items.meaning: to carry something toward someone; to present
items.meaningCN: 提供；主动提出（ob- 朝向 + ferre 携带）
items.example: She offered her seat to an elderly passenger.
items.exampleCN: 她把座位让给了一位年长乘客。

items.meaning: to carry something from under; to undergo hardship
items.meaningCN: 遭受；忍受（sub- 在下 + ferre 携带，即「在下面承受」）
items.example: The crops suffered from the long drought.
items.exampleCN: 庄稼因长期干旱而受损。

items.meaning: to carry a conclusion into the mind from evidence
items.meaningCN: 推断（in- 进入 + ferre 携带，即「把结论带进心中」）
items.example: From the wet floor we inferred that it had rained.
items.exampleCN: 从湿漉漉的地面我们推断下过雨。

latinEntries.meaning: to carry back; to report; to ascribe

definition_zh: 提及；参考；参考文献；推荐信；参照物；（计算机）引用
definition_en: a mention of something, a source consulted, or a point against which something else is judged
core_image: 书桌上摊开一本厚词典，页边贴着写有编号的便签
scene: 写论文的时候，老师反复叮嘱：每一条说法都要交代出处。The article makes frequent reference to earlier studies of the same topic.
sceneCN: 这里 reference 指「提及」（第 1 个义项：在言语或文字中说到某事物）；句意：这篇文章频繁提及对同一湖泊的早期研究。图中可辨识物件：打开的书、编号便签、书签、引用标记。

pos.zh: 提及；参考；参考文献；推荐信；参照物；查询
引用；参考（多用于学术与技术文本）

derivatives.zh: 提到；查询；转诊
裁判；推荐人；审稿
全民公投
指称的；参照的
转诊；转介

senses.title: A mention
senses.titleCN: 提及：在话语或文字中说到某事物
senses.definition: an act of mentioning someone or something in speech or writing
senses.definitionCN: 在口头或书面中说到某人或某事物的行为
senses.example: The article makes frequent reference to earlier studies.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章频繁提及早期的研究。
senses.why: Reference comes from referre 'to carry back', and a mention carries the reader's mind back to the thing named.
senses.whyCN: reference 出自 referre「带回」，而一次提及正是把读者的心思带回被命名的事物。

senses.title: A cited source
senses.titleCN: 参考文献：被引用的出处
senses.definition: a source cited in a text, or the entry that identifies it
senses.definitionCN: 正文所引用的出处，或标识该出处的条目
senses.example: Every claim in the paper has a reference at the end of the sentence.
senses.exampleCN: 论文中每一处主张在句末都有参考文献。
senses.why: The same carrying-back motion now points at a document: the text sends the reader to the place where the claim came from.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「带回」动作现在指向文件：正文把读者送回主张的来源之处。

senses.title: A reference work
senses.titleCN: 工具书：供查阅而非通读的书
senses.definition: a book or database consulted for specific facts rather than read through
senses.definitionCN: 为查具体事实而查阅、而非从头读到尾的书或数据库
senses.example: The librarian keeps the dictionaries and atlases in the reference section.
senses.exampleCN: 图书管理员把词典与地图集放在参考区。
senses.why: Here the noun has become a label for a class of books whose purpose is to be referred to.
senses.whyCN: 这里名词已成为一类书籍的标签，这类书的存在就是为了被查阅。

senses.title: A recommendation
senses.titleCN: 推荐信：为求职者作证的文件
senses.definition: a letter or statement in which someone speaks in support of an applicant
senses.definitionCN: 某人为申请人提供支持的书面陈述或信件
senses.example: She asked her former manager for a reference.
senses.exampleCN: 她请前任经理写一封推荐信。
senses.why: The recommender 'refers' the employer back to facts about the candidate, so the letter is called a reference.
senses.whyCN: 推荐人把雇主「引回」候选人的事实，因此这封信叫 reference。

senses.title: A basis for comparison
senses.titleCN: 参照物：用来比较的基准
senses.definition: a standard, point or system against which other things are measured or understood
senses.definitionCN: 用于衡量或理解其他事物的标准、点或系统
senses.example: The fixed stars provided a reference for early navigators.
senses.exampleCN: 恒星为早期航海者提供了参照。
senses.why: To refer is to send something back to a fixed point; a reference point is exactly that anchor.
senses.whyCN: refer 就是把某物送回一个固定点；reference point 正是这样的锚点。

senses.title: A computing reference
senses.titleCN: 计算机引用：指向对象或地址的间接名称
senses.definition: in computing, a value that points to an object or memory location rather than holding the data itself
senses.definitionCN: 计算机中指向对象或内存位置、而非直接保存数据的值
senses.example: The function returns a reference to the cached record.
senses.exampleCN: 该函数返回对缓存记录的引用。
senses.why: Programming borrowed the everyday idea of pointing back: a reference lets the program reach the original object without copying it.
senses.whyCN: 编程借用了「指回」的日常观念：引用让程序无需复制就能抵达原对象。

senses.title: A linguistic referent
senses.titleCN: 语言指称：词语所指的对象
senses.definition: in linguistics, the object or entity in the world that a word or phrase points to
senses.definitionCN: 语言学中词语或短语所指向的现实对象或实体
senses.example: The reference of 'the mayor' depends on who holds office.
senses.exampleCN: 「市长」一词的指称取决于谁在任。
senses.why: Linguists separated the word from the thing: the expression refers, and its reference is the thing it reaches.
senses.whyCN: 语言学家把词与物分开：表达式进行指称，而它的 reference 就是所抵达之物。

senses.title: An employment inquiry
senses.titleCN: 背景查询：向原单位核实情况
senses.definition: an inquiry made to a previous employer or institution about a person's record
senses.definitionCN: 向原雇主或机构核实某人履历的查询
senses.example: The hiring manager made a reference call before the offer.
senses.exampleCN: 发出录用通知前，招聘经理打了背景核实电话。
senses.why: The HR sense extends the document sense into a process: someone is asked to refer the new employer back to the record.
senses.whyCN: 人事义把文件义扩展为过程：有人被请求把新雇主引回履历记录。

intro.en: Reference comes from Latin referre 'to carry back', built on ferre 'to bear, carry'. English took the noun through French and Medieval Latin forms, and the modern senses range from mention to citation.
intro.cn: reference 出自拉丁 referre「带回」，基于 ferre「携带、承受」。英语经由法语与中世纪拉丁形式取得该名词，现代义从「提及」一直延伸到「引用」。

items.en: Latin ferre meant 'to bear, carry, bring'. Its compounds include transfer, offer, infer, refer and prefer, each with a different prefix direction.
items.cn: 拉丁 ferre 意为「携带、运送、带来」，其复合词包括 transfer、offer、infer、refer、prefer，各前缀设定不同方向。

items.en: Referre joined re- 'back' to ferre, meaning 'to carry back, bring back, direct to'. It could refer a question to a person or a matter to a source.
items.cn: referre 把 re-「回」加到 ferre，意为「带回、拿回、指向」，可用于把问题交给某人，或把事项指向某来源。

items.en: Medieval Latin referentia and French reference supplied the noun 'a referring, a relation'. The exact route into English is uncertain in detail.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁 referentia 与法语 reference 提供了「指涉、关联」的名词。进入英语的确切路径细节存疑。

items.en: English reference developed from 'relation or respect' to 'a mention', then to 'a cited source' and 'a recommendation'.
items.cn: 英语 reference 从「关联、方面」发展为「提及」，再发展为「被引出处」与「推荐」。

items.en: Computing added the pointer sense in the twentieth century, while linguistics fixed reference as the relation between expression and object.
items.cn: 20 世纪计算机领域增加了「指针」义，语言学则把 reference 固定为表达式与对象之间的关系。

items.en: The precise first English date is uncertain, and the deeper origin of ferre is discussed only as a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词根与传入路径）：英语最早书证确切年代存疑；ferre 的更深来源只作为重构来讨论。

note.en: The first group separates the refer family; the second gives near-synonyms for mentioning, citing or a standard of comparison.
note.cn: 第一组区分 refer 词族；第二组给出关于提及、引用或比较基准的近义词。

entries.definition: To mention, consult or direct someone to something. The noun reference names the mention or the source.
entries.definitionCN: 指提及、查阅或把某人引向某物；名词 reference 命名该提及或出处。

entries.definition: A sports official or a person who writes a recommendation. A referee is a person; a reference may be a document.
entries.definitionCN: 指体育裁判或写推荐的人。referee 是人，reference 可以是文件。

entries.definition: The act of sending someone to another doctor or service. It is the transfer, not the cited source.
entries.definitionCN: 指把某人转给另一位医生或服务；是转介行为，不是被引出处。

entries.definition: In linguistics, the actual object a word points to. Reference is the relation; the referent is the target.
entries.definitionCN: 语言学中词语指向的实际对象。reference 是关系，referent 是目标。

entries.definition: A formal quotation of a source with identifying details. It is narrower than reference, which can also mean a mere mention.
entries.definitionCN: 指带识别信息的正式引用；比 reference 窄，后者也可仅指提及。

entries.definition: An indirect or passing mention meant to be recognized. It does not provide a source.
entries.definitionCN: 指有意让人识别出的间接或顺带提及，不提供出处。

entries.definition: A rule or measure used for comparison. A reference point anchors measurement; a standard defines what counts as acceptable.
entries.definitionCN: 指用于比较的规则或尺度。参照点用于锚定测量；标准则界定何为合格。

entries.definition: The origin of information or material. A reference identifies a source, but the source is the thing itself.
entries.definitionCN: 指信息或材料的来源。reference 标识出处，而 source 是那个来源本身。

entries.definition: A written statement praising a person's qualities, often for employment. It overlaps sense 4 but stresses praise.
entries.definitionCN: 指称赞某人品质的书面陈述，常用于求职；与第 4 个义项重叠，但更强调赞扬。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: re- 'back' + ferre 'carry' + -ence: carrying the mind back to a source.
normal.cn: re-「回」+ ferre「携带」+ -ence：把心思带回某个来源。

normal.en: The family runs refer, referee, referral, referendum, referential.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 refer、referee、referral、referendum、referential。

normal.en: Fixed phrases show the senses: with reference to, reference book, frame of reference, letter of reference.
normal.cn: 固定搭配展示义项：关于、工具书、参照系、推荐信。

normal.en: A reference points back; a referent is the thing pointed at.
normal.cn: reference 指回，referent 是被指的东西。

normal.en: citation is formal quoting; allusion is indirect mention without a source.
normal.cn: citation 是正式引用；allusion 是不给出处的间接提及。

abstract.en: Picture a bookmark that sends your finger back to one exact page.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚书签把你的手指送回确切的一页。

abstract.en: Picture a surveyor's pole standing fixed while everything else is measured against it.
abstract.cn: 想象测量员的标杆固定不动，其余一切都以它为基准。

abstract.en: Picture a thread tied from a note to the drawer where its evidence is kept.
abstract.cn: 想象一根线把便条连到存放证据的抽屉。

examples.en: The report makes no reference to the earlier failed trial.
examples.cn: 这份报告只字未提早先那次失败的试验。

examples.en: Keep a reference list in the same style throughout the thesis.
examples.cn: 整篇论文的参考文献表要保持同一体例。

examples.en: The compass needle needs a fixed reference to show direction.
examples.cn: 罗盘指针需要一个固定参照才能显示方向。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（回）+ fer（带）」——把话头带回原处 → reference 提及、参考

root: 拉丁 ferre「携带」→ referre「带回、指向」→ 中世纪拉丁 referentia；英语 reference。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all point back: a mention points to a topic, a citation to a source, a reference book to facts, a letter to a record, a point to a scale, a variable to an object, a word to a referent, a call to an employer.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在「指回」：提及指向话题，引用指向出处，工具书指向事实，推荐信指向履历，参照点指向尺度，变量指向对象，词语指向指称物，核实电话指向雇主。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bookmark sending the finger back to one exact page.
core.cn: 核心意象：书签把手指送回确切的一页。

branches.en: TEXTUAL POINTING: a mention in prose, and the cited source that backs it.
branches.cn: 文本指涉：文中的提及，以及支撑它的被引出处。

branches.en: DOCUMENTS: a book made for consultation, or a letter that points an employer to a record.
branches.cn: 文件：为查阅而作的书，或把雇主引向履历的信。

branches.en: MEASUREMENT: a fixed point or frame against which things are judged.
branches.cn: 测量：用于判断事物的固定点或框架。

branches.en: SYMBOLIC POINTING: a program value or a word reaches an object without being that object.
branches.cn: 符号指涉：程序值或词语抵达对象，却不等于对象本身。

branches.en: PROCEDURE: the document sense becomes a call that checks a record.
branches.cn: 程序：文件义变成核实履历的一通电话。

intro.en: Reference is a Latin verb of carrying plus a noun ending: re- 'back' + ferre 'carry' + -ence. The same root appears across a large family of English verbs of transfer.
intro.cn: reference 是拉丁「携带」动词加名词词尾：re-「回」+ ferre「携带」+ -ence。同一词根出现在大量英语「转移」动词中。

latinIntro.en: The ferre family includes refer, transfer, offer, infer, prefer, confer, differ and suffer; the shared image is bearing something from one place or person to another.
latinIntro.cn: ferre 词族包括 refer、transfer、offer、infer、prefer、confer、differ、suffer；共同意象是把某物从一处或一人带到另一处或另一人。

items.meaning: a pointing back; a mention or source
items.meaningCN: 指回；提及或出处
items.example: The book contains useful references to primary sources.
items.exampleCN: 这本书含有指向原始资料的有用参考。

items.meaning: to mention or direct attention
items.meaningCN: 提及；指向
items.example: The footnote refers to page 42.
items.exampleCN: 脚注指向第 42 页。

items.meaning: one to whom a matter is referred; an official
items.meaningCN: 被请来裁定的人；裁判
items.example: The referee stopped the match.
items.exampleCN: 裁判中止了比赛。

items.meaning: the act of sending someone onward
items.meaningCN: 把某人转介出去的行为
items.example: The doctor wrote a referral to a specialist.
items.exampleCN: 医生写了转诊单给专科医生。

items.structure: Latin referendum (that which must be referred)
items.meaning: a vote referred to the people
items.meaningCN: 交由全民表决的事项
items.example: The constitution was changed by referendum.
items.exampleCN: 宪法通过全民公投得以修改。

items.meaning: to carry across
items.meaningCN: 带过另一处
items.example: The files were transferred to a new server.
items.exampleCN: 文件被转移到新服务器。

items.meaning: to carry a conclusion into view
items.meaningCN: 把结论带入视野；推断
items.example: We inferred the cause from the pattern.
items.exampleCN: 我们从模式推断出原因。

items.meaning: to carry before others; to favour
items.meaningCN: 置于他物之前；偏好
items.example: She prefers tea to coffee.
items.exampleCN: 她更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。

definition_zh: 反射（光、热、声）；映出影像；表现；反映；反思；沉思；回顾
definition_en: to throw back light, sound, or heat, to show an image in a surface, to express or show something, or to think carefully about the past
core_image: 一束光打在平静的水面上，折了回来：表面留下一幅倒影，光本身被送回原处
scene: 湖面在午后的阳光下亮得像一块镜子，把整座山的轮廓都收了进去。The calm lake reflected the mountains perfectly.
sceneCN: 这里 reflect 是「映出影像」（第 2 个义项：表面呈现对面的样子）；句意：平静的湖面完整地映出群山。场景要点：无风的湖、镜子般的水面、岸上的山影。

pos.zh: 反射；映出；表现；反映
反射；映出影像；反思；沉思

collocations.phrase: reflect the reality of the market

derivatives.zh: 由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「倒影；反映；反思」
由动词加形容词后缀构成，义为「反射的；沉思的」
由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「反射器；反光镜」
由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「沉思地；若有所思地」

senses.title: Throw back light or heat
senses.definition: to send back light, sound, or heat from a surface instead of absorbing it
senses.definitionCN: 把照到表面的光、声或热送回去，而不是吸收
senses.example: Snow reflects most of the sunlight that lands on it.
senses.exampleCN: 雪会把落在它上面的大部分阳光反射回去。
senses.why: The Latin root flectere means 'to bend': the ray arrives, is bent at the surface, and travels away again.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 flectere 意为「弯曲」：光线到达表面，在那里被折了一下，又走了回去。

senses.title: Show an image on a surface
senses.definition: to show the picture of someone or something on a smooth surface such as water or a mirror
senses.definitionCN: 在水面、镜面等光滑表面上呈现人或物的形象
senses.example: Her face was reflected in the shop window as she passed.
senses.exampleCN: 她经过时，脸映在了商店橱窗上。
senses.why: The bent ray carries the picture back to the eye, so the surface shows what stands before it.
senses.whyCN: 被折返的光线把图画带回眼睛，于是表面就呈现出立在它面前的样子。

senses.title: Show the true state of something
senses.definition: to give a clear and accurate picture of a situation, feeling, or fact
senses.definitionCN: 对某种情况、情绪或事实给出清晰准确的图景
senses.example: The falling sales reflect the weaker demand this year.
senses.exampleCN: 销量下滑反映出今年需求疲软。
senses.why: If a surface can carry back a picture, a fact can carry back a situation: the result is the image of the cause.
senses.whyCN: 表面能把图画折回去，事实同样能把境况折回去：结果就是原因的倒影。

senses.title: Express a quality or feeling
senses.definition: to make a quality, mood, or opinion visible in behaviour, words, or appearance
senses.definitionCN: 让某种品质、心情或观点在言行或外表中显现出来
senses.example: His poems reflect the loneliness of city life.
senses.exampleCN: 他的诗流露出城市生活的孤独。
senses.why: The inner state bends outward onto the surface of what he makes, the way light bends off glass.
senses.whyCN: 内在的状态像光折离玻璃一样，弯折到他作品的外表上。

senses.title: Bring honour or blame to someone
senses.titleCN: 给某人带来荣誉或羞辱
senses.definition: to affect the good or bad opinion people have of someone, as in reflect well or badly on
senses.definitionCN: 影响人们对某人评价的好坏，用于 reflect well/badly on 结构
senses.example: The calm way she handled the crisis reflected well on the whole team.
senses.exampleCN: 她沉稳地化解危机，为整个团队增了光。
senses.why: What a person does bends back onto the group behind them: the deed is a light, the group is the surface it returns to.
senses.whyCN: 一个人的所作所为会弯折回他身后的集体：行为是光，集体是光返回的那个表面。

senses.title: Think deeply about something
senses.definition: to think carefully and at length about something, especially something from the past
senses.definitionCN: 对某事进行认真而长时间的思考，尤指对往事
senses.example: At night he sat quietly, reflecting on what the teacher had said.
senses.exampleCN: 夜里他静静坐着，思索老师那番话。
senses.why: Thought is described as light turned inward: the mind bends the picture back onto itself and looks at it again.
senses.whyCN: 思考被描述为转向内部的光：心灵把图景折回自身，再看一遍。

senses.title: Turn the mind back to the past
senses.definition: to remember and consider past events, sometimes with regret or satisfaction
senses.definitionCN: 回想并审视过去的事，有时带着遗憾或欣慰
senses.example: Reflecting on her career, she saw how each chance had mattered.
senses.exampleCN: 回顾职业生涯，她看清了每一次机会的分量。
senses.why: The prefix re- sends the beam backward in time: the mind is a mirror turned toward yesterday.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 re- 把光束转向时间深处：心灵成了一面朝向昨天的镜子。

senses.title: Bend a sound or signal back
senses.definition: of sound, radar, or a signal, to bounce back from a surface and return toward its sender
senses.definitionCN: 指声音、雷达波或信号从表面弹回，返回发送方
senses.example: The sonar signal reflected off the seabed and returned in seconds.
senses.exampleCN: 声呐信号从海底反射回来，几秒钟就到了。
senses.why: It is the physical sense extended to waves: anything that travels can be bent back by the right surface.
senses.whyCN: 这是物理义向波动的延伸：凡是会行进的东西，遇到合适的表面都能被折回去。

intro.en: Reflect comes from Latin reflectere 'to bend back', from re- 'back' + flectere 'to bend'. The physical sense of bending light arrived first, and the mental sense of bending thought back followed naturally.
intro.cn: reflect 来自拉丁语 reflectere「弯回」，由 re-「回」加 flectere「弯曲」构成。先是物理上弯折光线的意思，随后「把思绪折回」的心智义自然生长出来。

items.en: The reconstructed root *bleik- or related forms give Latin flectere 'to bend' and English flexible, flex. The shared picture is something soft enough to be bent.
items.cn: 一般认为重构词根 *bleik- 等形式生成了拉丁语 flectere「弯曲」与英语 flexible、flex。共同的图景是「软到能被弯折之物」。

items.en: Reflectere was a concrete verb: to bend something back, as a bow is bent. Applied to rays, it described a path that turns at a boundary and returns.
items.cn: reflectere 是个具体的动词：把某物弯回去，如同弯弓。用于光线时，它描述一条在边界处转弯返回的路径。

items.en: The verb appears in English by the late fourteenth century, first of light and vision, in translations of learned works on optics.
items.cn: 动词到十四世纪晚期已见于英语，最早用于光与视觉，出现在光学论著的译本中。

items.en: The mental sense 'turn the mind back upon a subject' develops in the sixteenth century, and by the seventeenth century the verb names serious deliberation.
items.cn: 「把心思折回某个题目」的心智义在十六世纪发展起来，到十七世纪该动词已指郑重的深思。

items.en: The senses 'mirror an image', 'show a situation' and 'reflect well or badly on someone' are all later extensions of the one idea: something sent back from a surface.
items.cn: 「映出影像」「反映情况」「为某人增光或抹黑」各义都是同一观念——「从表面送回之物」——的后续引申。

note.en: The first group gathers the family built on flectere 'bend', all sharing the idea of bending or being bent. The second group compares words for showing or mirroring something.
note.cn: 第一组汇集以 flectere「弯曲」为根的词族，共享「弯折或被弯折」的观念。第二组比较几个「显示或映照」的词。

entries.definition: the image sent back, the act of reflecting, or careful thought. It is the noun of the verb.
entries.definitionCN: 映出的影像、反射行为或深思。它是动词的名词形式。

entries.definition: able to bend without breaking. It keeps the plain root sense of flectere.
entries.definitionCN: 能弯折而不断裂的。它保留了 flectere 平实的本义。

entries.definition: to bend aside, turning something away from its course. Different prefix, same bending verb.
entries.definitionCN: 使偏转，把某物引离原有路线。前缀不同，弯折动词相同。

entries.definition: to bend the voice or a word form inward, as in grammar or tone.
entries.definitionCN: 使声音或词形向内曲折，如语法变化或语调。

entries.definition: bent around, as the accent mark shaped like a small bend. A relative from the same bending root.
entries.definitionCN: 绕弯的，如形状似弯折的声调符号。同一弯折词根的亲戚。

entries.definition: to show an image or a situation as an exact copy. Mirror stresses likeness; reflect allows any surface and any accuracy.
entries.definitionCN: 像拷贝一样映出影像或情况。mirror 强调相似；reflect 不限表面，也不要求分毫不差。

entries.definition: to point to a fact or state. It suggests a sign; reflect suggests a true image carried back from reality.
entries.definitionCN: 指向某个事实或状态。indicate 侧重「迹象」；reflect 侧重「从现实折回的真实图景」。

entries.definition: to weigh something in the mind over time. Ponder is weighing; reflect is turning the picture back and looking again.
entries.definitionCN: 长时间在心里掂量某事。ponder 是称量；reflect 是把图景折回再看一遍。

entries.definition: to look at or think about something steadily and deeply. It is broader than reflect and need not involve the past.
entries.definitionCN: 专注而深入地注视或思考某事。它比 reflect 宽泛，不一定涉及过去。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: Latin re- 'back' + flectere 'bend', the family reflection, flexible, deflect and inflect, and the image of a ray bent at a surface.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与真实同族词：拉丁语 re-「回」加 flectere「弯曲」，词族 reflection、flexible、deflect、inflect，以及光线在表面折返的图景。

normal.en: re- means back and flectere means bend: to reflect is to bend something back where it came from.
normal.cn: re- 是「回」，flectere 是「弯曲」：reflect 就是把某物沿来路折回去。

normal.en: Flexible and reflect share the root: one thing bends in the hand, the other bends on a surface.
normal.cn: flexible 与 reflect 同根：一样在手心里弯，一样在表面上弯。

normal.en: A mirror, water, and glass all work the same way: the ray is bent and the picture travels back to your eye.
normal.cn: 镜子、水、玻璃原理相同：光被折弯，图画便回到了你的眼睛里。

normal.en: Facts and behaviour reflect like light: falling sales are the bent-back image of weak demand.
normal.cn: 事实与行为像光一样反射：销量下滑就是需求疲软折回来的倒影。

normal.en: Reflect on means to turn the beam inward: the mind becomes the surface the light returns to.
normal.cn: reflect on 就是把光束转向内部：心灵成了光折回去的那个表面。

abstract.en: Picture a still pond at sunset: every mountain and cloud sits upside down in the water.
abstract.cn: 想象日落时的静水潭：每座山、每片云都倒立在水中。

abstract.en: A mind that reflects is a quiet pond: the past leans over it and is seen clearly.
abstract.cn: 会反思的心是一片静水：往事俯下身来，被看得清清楚楚。

abstract.en: Reflect is about return, not creation: the surface adds nothing, it only sends back what arrives.
abstract.cn: reflect 关键在于「回送」而非「创造」：表面不添加任何东西，只把来到的送回去。

examples.en: White roofs reflect heat and keep the rooms below cooler.
examples.cn: 白色屋顶反射热量，让下面的房间更凉快。

examples.en: The report reflects months of careful field work.
examples.cn: 这份报告凝聚了数月细致的实地工作。

examples.en: Before deciding, he reflected on the advice his father had given him.
examples.cn: 做决定之前，他反复思量父亲给过的忠告。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞福来克的」——瑞福照镜子，福字「来克的」被镜面折了回来 → reflect 反射；映出；反映；反思（只借音，不表词源）

root: 源自拉丁语 reflectere「弯回」（re- 回 + flectere 弯曲），核心是「在表面处被折返、沿来路回去」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of reflect, all from one event: something arrives at a surface, is bent back, and returns — a ray, an image, a fact, or a thought.
sensesIntro.cn: reflect 的八个义项都来自同一件事：某物抵达表面、被折弯、再返回——可以是一束光、一幅影像、一个事实，或一个念头。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ray that hits a surface and bends back along its path.
core.cn: 核心意象：一束光抵达表面，沿来路折返。

branches.en: PHYSICS: light, heat, sound, and signals are all bent back from a boundary.
branches.cn: 物理：光、热、声与信号都在边界处被折回。

branches.en: IMAGE: the bent ray carries a picture back to the eye, and the surface seems to show it.
branches.cn: 影像：折返的光把图画带回眼睛，表面便呈现出它。

branches.en: SHOWING: situations, qualities, and reputations are carried back on the surface of facts and deeds.
branches.cn: 显示：境况、品质与名声在事实和行为的表面被折回。

branches.en: THINKING: the beam is turned inward, and the mind studies its own picture.
branches.cn: 思考：光束转向内部，心灵端详自己的图画。

branches.en: TIME: the prefix re- points the mirror toward yesterday, and the past is reviewed.
branches.cn: 时间：前缀 re- 把镜子朝向昨天，往事被重新审视。

intro.en: Reflect carries the Latin prefix re- 'back' on the stem flectere 'to bend'. English keeps a whole shelf of flectere words: flexible, deflect, inflect, reflection and circumflex.
intro.cn: reflect 在词干 flectere「弯曲」上带有拉丁前缀 re-「回」。英语保存了一整架 flectere 词：flexible、deflect、inflect、reflection、circumflex。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is reflectere 'bend back' (re- 'back' + flectere 'bend, curve'). Flectere also gives English flex words through flectere itself and through its participle flexus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语源头是 reflectere「弯回」（re-「回」+ flectere「弯曲」）。flectere 也通过自身及分词 flexus 生成了英语的 flex 词族。

items.meaning: to bend back; to mirror; to think over
items.meaningCN: 折回；映照；反思（re- 回 + flectere 弯曲）
items.example: The windows reflect the evening sky.
items.exampleCN: 窗户映出傍晚的天空。

items.meaning: an image bent back; careful thought
items.meaningCN: 倒影；反思（-ion 构成行为或结果名词）
items.example: She saw her reflection in the lake.
items.exampleCN: 她在湖里看见自己的倒影。

items.meaning: able to bend without breaking
items.meaningCN: 柔韧的；灵活的（-ible 表示可被…的）
items.example: The schedule stays flexible for emergencies.
items.exampleCN: 日程保持灵活以应对突发情况。

items.meaning: to bend aside; to turn away a blow or question
items.meaningCN: 使偏转；岔开（de- 离开 + flectere 弯曲）
items.example: The armour deflected the blow.
items.exampleCN: 护甲挡偏了那一击。

items.meaning: to bend inward; to vary the tone or form of a word
items.meaningCN: 使屈折变化；改变语调（in- 向内 + flectere 弯曲）
items.example: Many European languages inflect their nouns.
items.exampleCN: 许多欧洲语言的名词有屈折变化。

items.meaning: bent around; the accent mark shaped like a bend
items.meaningCN: 绕弯的；扬抑符（circum- 环绕 + flectere 弯曲）
items.example: The word fête carries a circumflex.
items.exampleCN: fête 一词带有扬抑符。

items.meaning: able to reflect; given to deep thought
items.meaningCN: 反射的；沉思的（-ive 构成形容词）
items.example: He was in a reflective mood after the reunion.
items.exampleCN: 聚会之后他若有所思。

items.meaning: a device that sends back light or heat
items.meaningCN: 反射器；反光镜（-or 表示装置或施动者）
items.example: Bicycles carry small red reflectors at night.
items.exampleCN: 自行车夜间装有红色小反光片。

items.meaning: an automatic bodily response
items.meaningCN: 反射动作；本能反应（由分词 flexus 缩略而来）
items.example: The doctor tested the reflexes at her knee.
items.exampleCN: 医生检测了她的膝部反射。

items.meaning: the act or amount of bending aside
items.meaningCN: 偏转；挠度（-ion 构成行为名词）
items.example: The bridge design limits the deflection of the span.
items.exampleCN: 桥梁设计限制了跨段的挠度。

definition_zh: 倒影；映像；反射；反映；深思；反思；想法；责备
definition_en: an image sent back from a surface, the throwing back of light or sound, a sign of something, or careful thought about the past
core_image: 水面或镜子里那幅被送回来的图画：你看着它，其实是在看被折返的自己
scene: 清晨起雾，玻璃窗上蒙着一层薄雾气，屋里的人影若隐若现。She saw her own reflection in the misted window.
sceneCN: 这里 reflection 是「映像；倒影」（第 1 个义项：表面送回的形象）；句意：她在蒙着雾气的窗上看见自己的映像。场景要点：薄雾、玻璃、模糊的人影。

pos.zh: 倒影；映像；反射；反映；深思；想法；责备

collocations.phrase: see one's reflection in the water
collocations.zh: 看见自己在水中的倒影

forms.label: 复数（多次映现、多次思考）

derivatives.zh: 同根动词，义为「反射；映出；反映；反思」
由名词词干加形容词后缀构成，义为「反射的；沉思的」
由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「反射器；反光镜」
由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「沉思地；若有所思地」

senses.title: The image sent back by a surface
senses.definition: an image of someone or something that appears in a mirror, water, or glass
senses.definitionCN: 出现在镜子、水面或玻璃中的人或物的形象
senses.example: The moon doubled itself in the still reflection of the bay.
senses.exampleCN: 月亮在海湾平静的倒影里又多了一个自己。
senses.why: The bent-back ray carries the picture to the eye: the image is what returns.
senses.whyCN: 折返的光线把图画带给眼睛：映像就是「回来的那幅画」。

senses.title: The throwing back of light or sound
senses.definition: the physical process of light, heat, or sound striking a surface and being sent back
senses.definitionCN: 光、热或声到达表面后被送回的物理过程
senses.example: The glow of sunset was a reflection off the wet pavement.
senses.exampleCN: 那片夕阳的亮光是湿漉漉的人行道反射出来的。
senses.why: Here the noun names the bending itself, not the picture: the event of the ray returning.
senses.whyCN: 这里名词命名的是「折返」这件事本身，而不是那幅画：即光线返回的过程。

senses.title: A clear sign of something
senses.definition: a thing that shows the true nature or state of something else, as in a reflection of
senses.definitionCN: 显示另一事物真实性质或状态的迹象，用于 a reflection of 结构
senses.example: Her patience with students is a reflection of her own schooling.
senses.exampleCN: 她对学生的耐心是她自己受教育经历的写照。
senses.why: A surface cannot invent what it sends back: so any faithful sign is called a reflection of what made it.
senses.whyCN: 表面无法凭空造出送回的东西：所以任何忠实的迹象都被称为「其来源的反映」。

senses.title: Careful thought
senses.definition: quiet, serious thinking about something, especially over some time
senses.definitionCN: 对某事安静而郑重的思索，常历时较久
senses.example: After a week of reflection he withdrew the application.
senses.exampleCN: 沉思一周后，他撤回了申请。
senses.why: The mind turns the beam inward and the picture returns to itself: thought is light bent back in the head.
senses.whyCN: 心灵把光束转向内部，图画回到自身：思考就是脑中折回的光。

senses.title: A thought written down
senses.definition: an idea or opinion produced by thinking, often shared in speech or writing
senses.definitionCN: 思考产生的想法或见解，常通过言谈或文字表达
senses.example: The last page of her diary holds her reflections on the journey.
senses.exampleCN: 她日记的最后一页写满了这次旅程的感想。
senses.why: What the bent-back beam showed becomes a shareable picture: an inward image put into words.
senses.whyCN: 折回光束所照见的，变成可以分享的图画：内在的映像落成了文字。

senses.title: Credit or blame carried back to someone
senses.definition: an effect on the good or bad opinion of someone, as in cast a reflection on
senses.definitionCN: 对某人名誉好坏的影响，用于 cast a reflection on 结构
senses.example: The bribery scandal cast a reflection on the whole department.
senses.exampleCN: 受贿丑闻给整个部门带来了不良影响。
senses.why: Deeds, like light, bend back onto the surface behind them: the group shares the image the act returns.
senses.whyCN: 行为如光，会折回其身后的表面：集体分担行为折回的那幅影像。

intro.en: Reflection comes from Latin reflexionem, the noun of action from reflectere 'to bend back'. The classical Latin form had an -x- (reflexio); the -ct- spelling was restored in learned English usage, and both spellings coexisted for centuries.
intro.cn: reflection 来自拉丁语 reflexionem，即 reflectere「弯回」的行为名词。古典拉丁语形式带 -x-（reflexio）；-ct- 拼写在英语书面语中被恢复，两种拼写曾并存数个世纪。

items.en: Reflexio / reflectionem is built on reflectere: re- 'back' + flectere 'bend'. It named the act of bending back, used of rays and of thought alike.
items.cn: reflexio／reflectionem 建立在 reflectere 上：re-「回」+ flectere「弯曲」。它命名「弯回」这一行为，既用于光线，也用于思想。

items.en: The noun appears in English by the late fourteenth century in learned contexts, chiefly of the turning back of rays, sight, and attention.
items.cn: 名词到十四世纪晚期已见于英语的学术语境，主要指光线、视线与注意力的折返。

items.en: The spellings reflexion and reflection coexisted in English for centuries; reflection gradually prevailed in British usage and became universal in American usage.
items.cn: reflexion 与 reflection 两种拼写在英语中并存数百年；reflection 渐成英式主流，并在美式英语中成为唯一形式。

items.en: The mental senses 'serious thought' and 'an idea resulting from thought' develop in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, extending the optical metaphor.
items.cn: 「郑重思考」与「思考所得的见解」等心智义在十六、十七世纪发展起来，延伸了光学的比喻。

items.en: Today the noun covers the mirrored image, the physical process, the faithful sign, the act of thought, its written result, and the honour or shame carried back to a person.
items.cn: 如今这个名词涵盖：镜像、物理过程、忠实的迹象、思考行为、其文字成果，以及折回某人身上的荣辱。

note.en: The first group gathers the flectere 'bend' family around the noun. The second group compares the nouns that name images, signs, and thought.
note.cn: 第一组汇集围绕该名词的 flectere「弯曲」词族。第二组比较命名影像、迹象与思考的名词。

entries.definition: an older British spelling of reflection, still seen in formal writing. Same word, older clothes.
entries.definitionCN: reflection 的旧式英拼，仍偶见于正式书面语。同一个词，旧式写法。

entries.definition: describing surfaces that send light back, or people given to thought. It is the adjective of the family.
entries.definitionCN: 描述能反光的表面，或惯于思考的人。它是词族中的形容词。

entries.definition: an automatic bodily response, from the same Latin participle. It keeps the classical -x- spelling.
entries.definitionCN: 身体的自动反应，出自同一拉丁分词，保留了古典的 -x- 拼写。

entries.definition: the bending of something aside from its course. Same noun shape, different direction.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物偏离路线的弯折。名词形式相同，方向不同。

entries.definition: a change in the tone of the voice or the form of a word. It bends inward, not back.
entries.definitionCN: 语调或词形的变化。它向内曲折，而非折回。

entries.definition: a picture of something, made by light, art, or imagination. Image is the picture itself; reflection adds the idea of return.
entries.definitionCN: 由光、艺术或想象造出的图像。image 只是图画；reflection 多一层「折返」之意。

entries.definition: a sound sent back, or an idea repeated. For sound, echo does the work that reflection does for light.
entries.definitionCN: 被送回的声音，或被重复的观点。声音领域的 echo 相当于光领域的 reflection。

entries.definition: long, deep thinking, often with a spiritual tinge. It stresses the act; reflection can also name the result.
entries.definitionCN: 长久而深入的思考，常带灵性色彩。它强调过程；reflection 还可指思考的结果。

entries.definition: steady, attentive thinking or gazing. It is longer and quieter than ordinary reflection.
entries.definitionCN: 专注的凝视或思索。比一般的 reflection 更久、更静。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: Latin re- 'back' + flectere 'bend', the noun suffix -ion, the family reflex, reflective and inflection, and the two spellings reflexion and reflection.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与真实同族词：拉丁语 re-「回」加 flectere「弯曲」，名词后缀 -ion，词族 reflex、reflective、inflection，以及 reflexion／reflection 两种拼写。

normal.en: The noun keeps the verb's grammar: reflection is the thing or the act of reflecting.
normal.cn: 名词继承动词的语法：reflection 就是 reflect 的结果或行为。

normal.en: The suffix -ion turns an action into a noun, like action from act.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ion 把动作变成名词，正如 act 变成 action。

normal.en: Reflex is the classical -x- cousin: the knee bends back all by itself.
normal.cn: reflex 是古典 -x- 拼写的表亲：膝盖自己就「折」了回去。

normal.en: Mirror, water and glass all give reflections; reports and faces give reflections of deeper things.
normal.cn: 镜子、水、玻璃给出倒影；报告与表情则给出深层事物的反映。

normal.en: After some reflection means after the beam has been bent inward and returned.
normal.cn: after some reflection 就是光束向内折返并返回之后。

abstract.en: Stand at the edge of a still lake at dusk: your double looks back up at you from the water.
abstract.cn: 黄昏时站在静湖边：你的「分身」从水里仰头望着你。

abstract.en: A quiet room with one lamp is enough for reflection: the mind leans over its own picture.
abstract.cn: 一间亮着一盏灯的静室就够人反思了：心灵俯身端详自己的图画。

abstract.en: Reflection is the answer a surface gives back: it never speaks first.
abstract.cn: reflection 是表面给出的回答：它从不先开口。

examples.en: The reflection of the towers stretched all the way across the river.
examples.cn: 高楼的倒影一直铺到河对岸。

examples.en: His bad temper is a reflection of the pressure he is under.
examples.cn: 他的坏脾气是他所承受压力的反映。

examples.en: She read her old essays and smiled at the reflections of her younger self.
examples.cn: 她读旧日的文章，为年轻时写下的感想而微笑。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞福来克申」——瑞福把申请书贴在镜前来克申，镜里也有一份折回来 → reflection 倒影；反思（只借音，不表词源）

root: 源自拉丁语 reflectere 的行为名词 reflexionem「弯回之事」（re- 回 + flectere 弯曲），核心是「被送回来的东西或折返的过程」。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses of reflection, all naming what comes back: an image, a ray, a true sign, a thought, a written idea, and the honour or shame a deed returns to its doer.
sensesIntro.cn: reflection 的六个义项都在命名「回来的东西」：一幅影像、一束光、一个真切的迹象、一番思考、一段写下的感想，以及行为折回本人的荣辱。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the picture or process that comes back from a surface.
core.cn: 核心意象：从表面折返回来的图画或过程。

chain: THE DEED RETURNS TO ITS DOER

branches.en: OPTICS: the image in the mirror and the bending of the ray itself are the two physical faces of one event.
branches.cn: 光学：镜中的影像与光线折返的过程，是同一件事的两个物理侧面。

branches.en: SIGN: anything that faithfully shows its origin is a reflection of that origin.
branches.cn: 迹象：凡忠实显示其来源之物，皆为其来源的反映。

branches.en: THOUGHT: the inward-bent beam produces the act of thinking and the ideas it leaves behind.
branches.cn: 思考：向内折回的光束产生思考行为，也留下思考的成果。

branches.en: REPUTATION: deeds bend back onto the person and group behind them.
branches.cn: 名誉：行为折回到其背后的人与集体身上。

branches.en: SURFACES EVERYWHERE: water, glass, facts and behaviour all share one job — returning what arrives.
branches.cn: 处处皆表面：水、玻璃、事实与行为共享同一份工作——把来到的东西送回去。

intro.en: Reflection adds the Latin noun suffix -ion to the stem flectere 'bend' with the prefix re- 'back'. The same stem with other prefixes gives inflection, deflection and circumflex.
intro.cn: reflection 在词干 flectere「弯曲」加前缀 re-「回」之上，附加拉丁名词后缀 -ion。同一词干配其他前缀生出 inflection、deflection、circumflex。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is reflexio, from reflectere 'bend back'. The action suffix -io / -ionem is among the most productive noun endings Latin handed to English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语源头是 reflexio，出自 reflectere「弯回」。行为后缀 -io／-ionem 是拉丁语传给英语的最高产名词词尾之一。

items.meaning: the act or result of bending back
items.meaningCN: 倒影；反映；反思（re- 回 + flectere 弯曲 + -ion 行为名词）
items.example: Her essay is a reflection on growing up.
items.exampleCN: 她的文章是对成长的反思。

items.meaning: same meaning as reflection
items.meaningCN: reflection 的旧式拼写（保留古典 -x-）
items.example: Older books print reflexion where modern ones print reflection.
items.exampleCN: 旧书印作 reflexion，现代书印作 reflection。

items.meaning: sending back light; given to thought
items.meaningCN: 反光的；沉思的（-ive 构成形容词）
items.example: The wet road was strangely reflective at night.
items.exampleCN: 湿漉漉的路面夜里反光异样地亮。

items.meaning: thought turned on oneself
items.meaningCN: 自我反省（self- 自身 + reflection）
items.example: Journal writing encourages self-reflection.
items.exampleCN: 写日记有助于自我反省。

items.meaning: a bend in tone or word form
items.meaningCN: 语调变化；屈折变化（in- 向内 + -ion）
items.example: A rising inflection can turn a statement into a question.
items.exampleCN: 上扬的语调能把陈述句变成疑问句。

items.meaning: a bend away from the course
items.meaningCN: 偏转；转移（de- 离开 + -ion）
items.example: The goalkeeper's deflection saved the goal.
items.exampleCN: 守门员一挡，球没进门。

items.meaning: the accent mark that bends over a vowel
items.meaningCN: 扬抑符（circum- 环绕 + flectere 弯曲）
items.example: Write rôle with its circumflex.
items.exampleCN: rôle 一词要带扬抑符。

items.meaning: an automatic response of the body
items.meaningCN: 反射动作（分词 flexus 缩略）
items.example: Pulling the hand away is a reflex.
items.exampleCN: 缩手是一种反射动作。

items.meaning: able to bend
items.meaningCN: 柔韧的；灵活的（-ible 表示可被…的）
items.example: A flexible plan survives surprises.
items.exampleCN: 灵活的计划经得起意外。

items.structure: native English cousin of the bending idea
items.meaning: to force something out of a straight line
items.meaningCN: 弄弯（英语本土的「弯曲」近义词，词源不同）
items.example: Bend the wire into a hook.
items.exampleCN: 把铁丝弯成钩子。

definition_zh: 改革；革新；改良；改造；改过自新；改革方案
definition_en: to change a system, law, or person's behaviour in order to make it better, or the change itself
core_image: 把一件走形的东西重新浇铸：旧模子被打破，新形状按更好的样子重新定型
scene: 议会大厦里的争论持续了整整一个冬天，新的税收制度终于通过了。Parliament passed a far-reaching tax reform last spring.
sceneCN: 这里 reform 是「改革方案」（第 6 个义项：作为名词的改革计划）；句意：议会去年春天通过了一项影响深远的税制改革。场景要点：议事厅、表决灯、文件上的条款。

pos.zh: 改革；改良；改造；使改过自新
改过自新；变得更好
改革；革新；改过自新

derivatives.zh: 由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「改革；改善；宗教改革运动」
由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「改革者；改革家」
由名词加形容词后缀构成，义为「主张改革的；改良主义的」
由动词加形容词后缀加名词后缀构成，义为「少年管教所」

senses.title: Change a system for the better
senses.definition: to change a system, organization, or law in order to remove faults and make it work better
senses.definitionCN: 为去除弊端、使其运转更好而改变制度、组织或法律
senses.example: The government promised to reform the pensions system.
senses.exampleCN: 政府承诺改革养老金制度。
senses.why: The Latin formare means 'to shape': reforming is shaping again, giving a faulty thing its form a second time, now with the faults removed.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 formare 意为「塑造」：reform 就是「再塑形」，把一件有毛病的东西重新定型，这次去掉毛病。

senses.title: Improve a practice or custom
senses.definition: to make a practice, habit, or method better by changing what is wrong in it
senses.definitionCN: 通过纠正其中的错误来改良某种做法、习惯或方法
senses.example: The club reformed its outdated training routine.
senses.exampleCN: 俱乐部改良了过时的训练流程。
senses.why: The thing reshaped here is not a law but a way of doing: the new shape replaces the old one piece by piece.
senses.whyCN: 这里被重塑的不是法律，而是做事方式：新形状一点一点替换掉旧的。

senses.title: Change a person for the better
senses.definition: to cause someone to give up bad behaviour and live a better life
senses.definitionCN: 使某人改掉坏行为，过上更好的生活
senses.example: The programme claims to reform young offenders through work and study.
senses.exampleCN: 该项目声称通过劳动与学习改造少年犯。
senses.why: A person, like an institution, can be given a new shape: the old habits are broken and better ones are cast in their place.
senses.whyCN: 人和机构一样可以被赋以新形状：旧习惯被打碎，更好的习惯浇铸进原处。

senses.title: Give up bad behaviour oneself
senses.definition: to stop behaving badly and improve one's own way of life, used without an object
senses.definitionCN: 指不再作恶、改善自己的生活方式，不带宾语使用
senses.example: After years of trouble he finally reformed and settled down.
senses.exampleCN: 经过多年动荡，他终于改过自新、安顿下来。
senses.why: The shaping verb turns reflexive: the person becomes both the reformer and the thing reformed.
senses.whyCN: 塑造动词转向自身：人既是改革者，又是被重塑之物。

senses.title: Reassemble after breaking up
senses.definition: to come together again or form again after a group or line has been broken up
senses.definitionCN: 指队伍或团体解散后重新集结、重新组成
senses.example: The party reformed three years after it split.
senses.exampleCN: 该党分裂三年后重新组建。
senses.why: The prefix re- does plain work here: form again — the same members take up the old shape, or a nearby one.
senses.whyCN: 这里前缀 re- 只做朴素的工作：再次成形——同一批成员恢复旧的形状，或接近旧的形状。

senses.title: A planned change for the better
senses.definition: a change made to a system, law, or practice in order to improve it
senses.definitionCN: 为改善制度、法律或做法而进行的变革
senses.example: The long-awaited tax reform finally reached Parliament.
senses.exampleCN: 期待已久的税制改革终于提交议会。
senses.why: The noun keeps the whole picture: the old shape, the breaking, and the new shape that replaces it.
senses.whyCN: 名词保留了整幅图景：旧形状、打破、以及取而代之的新形状。

senses.title: A person's improvement in character
senses.definition: the fact of a person giving up bad ways and becoming better
senses.definitionCN: 指一个人弃恶从善、变好的事实
senses.example: Everyone noticed his real reform after the months in the countryside.
senses.exampleCN: 大家都注意到他在乡下几个月后真正的转变。
senses.why: The reshaped thing is now a life: the noun names the new shape a person has taken on.
senses.whyCN: 此时被重塑的是一段人生：名词命名了一个人呈现出的新形状。

intro.en: Reform comes from Old French reformer, from Latin reformare 'to form again, reshape', from re- 'again' + formare 'to form, shape'. The Latin verb was already used of moral reshaping, and English kept both the institutional and the personal senses.
intro.cn: reform 来自古法语 reformer，上溯拉丁语 reformare「再次成形、重塑」，由 re-「再」加 formare「塑造」构成。拉丁语动词已用于道德重塑，英语同时保留了制度义与个人义。

items.en: The reconstructed root *dher- 'to hold, support, set' underlies Latin forma 'shape, figure', itself of uncertain earlier origin, though often linked to this root.
items.cn: 一般认为重构词根 *dher-「持、撑、置放」是拉丁语 forma「形状」的来源；forma 更早的出处不确定，常被联系到该词根。
