items.meaningCN: 在地区层面（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The prizes are judged regionally first.
items.exampleCN: 奖项先按地区评选。

items.meaning: to organize by regions
items.meaningCN: 使按地区划分（-ize 表示「使成为」）
items.example: The company regionalized its sales teams.
items.exampleCN: 公司把销售团队按地区重组了。

items.meaning: following a rule; even in spacing
items.meaningCN: 规律的；规则的（-ar 构成形容词）
items.example: Regular sleep keeps the body steady.
items.exampleCN: 规律睡眠让身体保持平稳。

items.meaning: to control by rules
items.meaningCN: 管制；调节（-ate 构成动词）
items.example: Rules regulate the use of parkland.
items.exampleCN: 规则管制着公园用地的使用。

items.meaning: a system of rule; a planned routine
items.meaningCN: 政权；体制；方案（-men 构成结果名词）
items.example: The training regime lasts six weeks.
items.exampleCN: 训练方案为期六周。

items.meaning: between nations; crossing the biggest circles
items.meaningCN: 国际的（inter- 之间 + nation + -al，是同一套圆圈之外的更大范围）
items.example: International flights leave from Terminal Two.
items.exampleCN: 国际航班从第二航站楼出发。

items.meaning: land under one authority
items.meaningCN: 领土；属地（出自 terra「土地」，与 region 词源不同但义近）
items.example: Dogs defend their territory against strangers.
items.exampleCN: 狗会防御领地不受陌生者侵犯。

definition_zh: 登记册；记录器；收银机；音域；语域；寄存器；登记；注册；显示（读数）；流露出（神情）
definition_en: an official book or list of records, a device that records data, a range of a voice or instrument, or to write something into a list and show a reading
core_image: 一本摊在柜台上的厚册子，每来一个人、每做一笔账，就在格子里添上一行
scene: 研究所门口，访客必须先在前台登记姓名才能进楼。Every visitor must register at the front desk before entering the building.
sceneCN: 这里 register 是「登记姓名」（第 7 个义项：把自己的名字写进名单）；句意：每位来访者进厂前都必须在前台登记姓名。场景要点：前台、翻开的登记簿、递过来的笔、挂在胸前的访客证。

pos.zh: 登记册；记录器；收银机；音域；语域；寄存器
登记；注册；显示（读数）；流露出（神情）

collocations.zh: 在诊所登记（成为其病人）

derivatives.zh: 登记；注册；挂号
登记处；注册表；登记簿
登记员；注册主任；户籍员
登记者；注册人
已登记的；注册的；挂号的

senses.title: The book that holds the entries
senses.definition: an official book or list in which names, events, or amounts are written down and kept
senses.definitionCN: 正式记录姓名、事件或金额并加以保存的册子或名单
senses.example: The parish register records every birth and marriage since 1700.
senses.exampleCN: 这个教区登记簿记录了 1700 年以来每一次出生与婚姻。
senses.why: The Latin verb regerere meant 'carry back': events were carried back into a book so that they would not be lost. The book is that carried-back record.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语动词 regerere 意为“带回来”：发生的事情被带回一本册子里，以免丢失。这本册子就是那份被带回的记录。

senses.title: The machine that rings up a sale
senses.definition: a machine that records the amount of money taken in a sale and keeps a running total
senses.definitionCN: 记录每笔交易金额并累计总额的机器
senses.example: She opened the cash register and counted the morning's takings.
senses.exampleCN: 她打开收银机，清点了上午的收入。
senses.why: Once entries were kept by a machine rather than a clerk, the name of the book moved to the box: the register registers each sale as it happens.
senses.whyCN: 当条目由机器而不是店员来记录，这本册子的名字就转移到了那只箱子上：收银机在每笔交易发生时把它记下来。

senses.title: The range of a voice or instrument
senses.definition: the range of pitches that a voice or instrument can produce, or a part of that range with a distinct quality
senses.definitionCN: 人声或乐器能发出的音高范围，或其中音质独特的一段
senses.example: The soprano's upper register was clear and effortless.
senses.exampleCN: 那位女高音的高音区清亮而毫不费力。
senses.why: A register was first a list, then the compass of a voice — the full list of notes it can reach. The musical sense, recorded in 1811, treats pitch as entries on a scale.
senses.whyCN: register 先是一份名单，再是一个声音的“音域”——它能达到的全部音符的名单。音乐义记录于 1811 年，把音高当作同一把尺子上的条目。

senses.title: The level of language a situation calls for
senses.definition: in linguistics, a style or level of language used in a particular social situation
senses.definitionCN: 语言学中指在特定社会场合所使用的语言风格或层次
senses.example: The report was written in a formal academic register.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告用的是正式的学术语体。
senses.why: The musical idea of a range or level was carried into language: a speaker moves between formal and casual registers much as a voice moves between high and low.
senses.whyCN: 音乐里“音域、层次”的观念被带进了语言：说话人在正式与随意之间切换语体，正如人声在高音与低音之间移动。

senses.title: A slot inside a processor
senses.titleCN: 处理器里的一个存储槽
senses.definition: in computing, a small, fast storage location inside a processor that holds one piece of data during an operation
senses.definitionCN: 计算机中指处理器内部容量很小、速度很快的存储位置，在一次运算中存放一项数据
senses.example: The program loads both numbers into registers before adding them.
senses.exampleCN: 程序先把两个数装进寄存器，然后再相加。
senses.why: A processor register is a numbered slot where a value is entered and kept, the smallest version of the ledger's ruled line.
senses.whyCN: 处理器寄存器是一个编号的格子，一个数值被“写进去”并保存在那里，它是账簿横线的最小版本。

senses.title: Write it into the record
senses.definition: to write a name, fact, or amount into an official list or system
senses.definitionCN: 把姓名、事实或金额写进正式的名单或系统
senses.example: The clerk registered the deed at the county office.
senses.exampleCN: 职员在县办事处登记了这份契约。
senses.why: This is the verb built directly on the noun: to register is to put an entry into the register.
senses.whyCN: 这是直接由名词构成的动词：to register 就是把一个条目放进登记册。

senses.title: Put your own name down
senses.definition: to add your own name to a list in order to take part in something
senses.definitionCN: 为参加某项活动而把自己的名字加入名单
senses.example: You must register to vote before the end of the month.
senses.exampleCN: 你必须在本月底之前登记才能投票。
senses.why: The verb turned reflexive in ordinary use: the person becomes both the writer and the entry. This sense is recorded from 1848.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词在日常使用中转向了自身：人既是书写者，也是被写下的那一条。这个义项记录于 1848 年。

senses.title: Show a reading on a dial
senses.definition: of an instrument, to show or record a measured value
senses.definitionCN: 指仪器显示或记录某个测得的数值
senses.example: The thermometer registered thirty degrees at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 正午时温度计显示三十度。
senses.why: An instrument registering is the machine doing the clerk's work: it enters the measurement into its own record and displays it.
senses.whyCN: 仪器 register，就是机器在做店员的活：它把测量结果写进自己的记录，并显示出来。

senses.title: Let an expression show
senses.definition: of a feeling, to appear on a face or in a voice before it is put into words
senses.definitionCN: 指某种情绪在说出口之前先显现在脸上或声音里
senses.example: Surprise registered on her face before she spoke.
senses.exampleCN: 她还没开口，惊讶就先显在了脸上。
senses.why: The 1901 sense treats the face as an instrument: the feeling reaches the surface and the dial moves.
senses.whyCN: 1901 年的这个义项把脸当作一台仪器：情绪抵达表面，表盘便动了。

intro.en: Register comes from Medieval Latin registrum, a much altered form of regestum, from Latin regerere 'carry back'. The second -r- was added by analogy, and some later senses were coloured by the unrelated regere 'rule'. Dates follow standard etymological references.
intro.cn: register 来自中世纪拉丁语 registrum，它是 regestum 经过大幅变形的形式，源头是拉丁语 regerere“带回”。第二个 -r- 是类比加上的，后来某些义项又受到无关的 regere“统治”影响。年代依据通行词源资料。

items.en: The noun registre is first recorded meaning 'public record book, private account book, an official written account regularly kept'.
items.cn: 名词 registre 最早记录于 14 世纪晚期，意为“公共记录簿、私人账簿、定期保存的正式书面记录”。

items.en: From Old French registre (13c.) and directly from Medieval Latin registrum, regestrum, properly regestum, from Late Latin regesta 'list, matters recorded'. The unetymological second -r- came by influence of Latin nouns in -istrum.
items.cn: 来自古法语 registre（13 世纪），并直接来自中世纪拉丁语 registrum、regestrum，本作 regestum，出自晚期拉丁语 regesta“清单、被记录的事项”。非词源的第二个 -r- 是受拉丁语 -istrum 类名词影响而加上的。

items.en: Regesta is the neuter plural of regestus, past participle of regerere 'to record; retort', literally 'to carry back, bring back', from re- 'back' + gerere 'carry, bear'. The record is what has been carried back.
items.cn: regesta 是 regestus 的中性复数，后者是 regerere 的过去分词，意为“记录；反驳”，字面是“带回、携回”，由 re-“回”加 gerere“携带、承载”构成。记录就是被带回来的东西。

items.en: Some later senses seem to have been influenced by association with unrelated Latin regere 'to rule, to guide, to keep straight'. Regere is not the source of register; the two families only resemble each other.
items.cn: 后来某些义项似乎受到无关的拉丁语 regere“统治、引导、使笔直”的联想影响。regere 并不是 register 的来源；两个词族只是形似。

items.en: The printing sense 'exact alignment of presswork' is from the 1680s. The musical sense 'compass or range of a voice or instrument' is from 1811, hence 'a series of tones of the same quality'. The sense 'device by which data is automatically recorded' is by 1830, from the verb.
items.cn: 印刷义“印件的精确对齐”始于 17 世纪 80 年代。音乐义“人声或乐器的音域”始于 1811 年，由此引申为“同一音质的一组音”。义项“自动记录数据的装置”到 1830 年已出现，来自动词。

items.en: The verb registren 'to record, enter in a listing' is late 14c.; 'enroll someone' is c.1400; instruments 'show a reading' 1797; 'enter one's own name' 1848; persons and feelings 'make an impression' by 1901. Registered nurse is attested from 1879.
items.cn: 动词 registren“记录、列入清单”为 14 世纪晚期；c.1400 起有“使某人登记入册”；仪器“显示读数”始于 1797 年；“写下自己的名字”始于 1848 年；人或情绪“留下印象”到 1901 年已出现。registered nurse（注册护士）见于 1879 年。

note.en: The first group separates register from its derived nouns, each of which names a different part of the act: the process, the office, the official, the person enrolled. The second group compares the verbs of putting something on a list.
note.cn: 第一组把 register 与它的派生名词分开，每个派生词命名这个行为的不同部分：过程、机构、官员、被登记的人。第二组比较几个“把某物列入名单”的动词。

entries.definition: the act or process of registering. It names the procedure, while register is the book or the act itself.
entries.definitionCN: 登记或注册的行为与过程。它命名程序，而 register 是册子或动作本身。

entries.definition: an office where records are kept, or a formal list or database. It is the place or the collection, not the single book on the counter.
entries.definitionCN: 保存记录的机构，或正式的名单、数据库。它是场所或集合，而不是柜台上那一本册子。

entries.definition: the official who keeps a register, especially at a university or hospital. It is the person, not the record.
entries.definitionCN: 保管登记册的官员，尤指大学或医院中的注册主任。它是人，而不是记录。

entries.definition: a person who registers, especially for a course, exam, or event. It is the person on the list, not the person keeping it.
entries.definitionCN: 进行登记的人，尤指报名课程、考试或活动者。它是名单上的人，而不是保管名单的人。

entries.definition: to store information so that it can be found later. It is broader than register: you can record a sound or a fact without entering it in an official list.
entries.definitionCN: 把信息存下来以便日后查找。它比 register 宽：你可以记录一段声音或一个事实，而不必把它写进正式名单。

entries.definition: to join a school, course, or organization by having your name entered on its list. It focuses on becoming a member, while register focuses on the act of writing the name down.
entries.definitionCN: 通过把名字列入名单而加入学校、课程或组织。它强调成为成员，而 register 强调写下名字这个动作。

entries.definition: to put your name down for something, usually in everyday speech. It is the informal phrasal equivalent of register for a course or event.
entries.definitionCN: 报名参加某事，通常用于日常口语。它是 register 用于课程或活动时的非正式短语对应语。

entries.definition: to write down events in a regular record as they happen, especially for technical or official purposes. A log is continuous; a register is often a formal list of names or transactions.
entries.definitionCN: 随着事件发生而定期写入记录，尤用于技术或正式目的。日志是连续的；登记册通常是姓名或交易的正式名单。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: Latin re- 'back' + gerere 'carry', the Medieval Latin registrum, and the English family registration, registry, registrar and registrant.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与真实同族词：拉丁语 re-“回”加 gerere“携带”、中世纪拉丁语 registrum，以及英语词族 registration、registry、registrar、registrant。

normal.en: regerere means 'carry back': an event is carried back into a book so that it can be found again.
normal.cn: regerere 意为“带回”：一件事被带回册子里，以便日后还能找到。

normal.en: The second -r- in registrum is unetymological, added by analogy with nouns ending in -istrum. It is not part of the root.
normal.cn: registrum 里的第二个 -r- 不是词源原有的，而是类比 -istrum 结尾的名词加上去的。它不属于词根。

normal.en: regere 'rule' is a different verb. It coloured some later senses but did not father the word.
normal.cn: regere“统治”是另一个动词。它影响了后来某些义项，却不是这个词的来源。

normal.en: The verb has two everyday branches: write something in (register a deed), and put your own name down (register to vote).
normal.cn: 动词有两个日常分支：把某物写进去（登记契约），以及写下自己的名字（登记投票）。

normal.en: An instrument registers a reading, and a face registers a feeling: both are dials that move when something arrives.
normal.cn: 仪器 register 一个读数，脸 register 一种情绪：两者都是“有东西到达时表盘就动”的仪器。

abstract.en: Picture a ledger open on a counter. Every arrival gets one line, and the line stays after the person has gone.
abstract.cn: 想象一本摊在柜台上的账簿。每来一个人就添一行，人走了，这一行还留着。

abstract.en: From that book the word spreads in three directions: the machine that writes the lines, the range of notes written on a musical scale, and the slot where a processor keeps one value.
abstract.cn: 从这个册子出发，这个词向三个方向扩散：替人写行的机器、写在音阶上的音域，以及处理器保存一个数值的格子。

abstract.en: Register is about entry, not memory: the point is that the name or number has been formally put in, not that someone remembers it.
abstract.cn: register 的关键是“入册”，而不是记忆：重点在于姓名或数字已被正式写进去，而不在于有人记得它。

examples.en: All births and deaths are registered at the town hall.
examples.cn: 所有出生与死亡都在市政厅登记。

examples.en: The university requires new students to register before orientation.
examples.cn: 大学要求新生在迎新之前完成注册。

examples.en: The gauge registered a sudden drop in pressure.
examples.cn: 压力表显示压力突然下降。

dict_mnemonic.text: “日记斯特”——日记斯特把每天来往的人和账都记进一本厚册子 → register 登记；登记册（只借音，不表词源）

root: 源自中世纪拉丁语 registrum，上溯拉丁语 regerere“带回、记录”（re- 回 + gerere 携带），核心是“把发生的事带回册子里写下来”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of register, all from one object: a ruled book in which each name, sale, note, or value gets its own line, and the act of putting that line there.
sensesIntro.cn: register 的九个义项都围绕同一件东西：一本划了格子的册子，每个姓名、每笔交易、每个音符、每个数值都占一行；以及把这一行写进去的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ledger open on a counter, one line added for each entry.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本摊在柜台上的账簿，每记一项就添一行。

branches.en: THE BOOK: the original sense is the official volume itself, where names and events are kept in ruled lines.
branches.cn: 册子：最原始的义项就是这本正式簿册，姓名与事件被保存在划好的行里。

branches.en: MACHINES AND SLOTS: the cash register writes the line for us, and the processor register is the smallest ruled slot of all.
branches.cn: 机器与存储槽：收银机替我们写这一行，处理器寄存器则是所有格子里最小的一个。

branches.en: RANGE AND LEVEL: a voice's register is its full list of notes; a language register is the level a situation calls for.
branches.cn: 范围与层次：人声的音域是它全部音符的名单；语域则是场合所要求的语言层次。

branches.en: WRITING NAMES IN: the verb records someone else's entry, or turns reflexive and writes one's own name.
branches.cn: 写入姓名：动词既记录别人的条目，也可转向自身、写下自己的名字。

branches.en: SHOWING: instruments and faces register readings and feelings, as if a dial moved when something arrived.
branches.cn: 显示：仪器与脸分别 register 读数和情绪，仿佛有东西到达时表盘就动了。

intro.en: Register is a Latin-derived noun whose visible ending is -ister/-istery in its medieval forms, not a living English suffix. English builds registration, registry, registrar and registrant on the finished word, and the root gerere also reaches English through gesture, suggest and digest.
intro.cn: register 是源自拉丁语的名词，其中世纪形式里看得见的词尾是 -ister／-istery，并非活的英语后缀。英语在成品词上构成 registration、registry、registrar、registrant；词根 gerere 还通过 gesture、suggest、digest 进入英语。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is regerere 'carry back, record' (re- 'back' + gerere 'carry, bear'). Its past participle regestus became regesta 'things recorded', then Medieval Latin registrum. Gerere is a busy verb: it also gives gesture, digest, suggest, congest and register itself.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语源头是 regerere“带回、记录”（re-“回”+ gerere“携带、承载”）。其过去分词 regestus 变成 regesta“被记录的事项”，再变成中世纪拉丁语 registrum。gerere 是个繁忙的动词：gesture、digest、suggest、congest 以及 register 本身都出自它。

items.meaning: a book of carried-back records; to enter in it
items.meaningCN: 把记录带回的册子；登记入册（re- 回 + gerere 携带，经 regestus／registrum）
items.example: The hotel keeps a register of all guests.
items.exampleCN: 旅馆保存着所有客人的登记册。

items.meaning: the process of registering
items.meaningCN: 登记；注册（过程）（-ation 构成过程名词）
items.example: Registration closes on the first of September.
items.exampleCN: 注册在九月一日截止。

items.meaning: an office or list where records are kept
items.meaningCN: 登记处；注册表（-y 表示机构或集合）
items.example: The land registry holds every title deed.
items.exampleCN: 土地登记处保存着每一份地契。

items.meaning: the official who keeps the register
items.meaningCN: 登记员；注册主任（-ar 表示任职者）
items.example: The registrar signed the marriage certificate.
items.exampleCN: 登记员签署了结婚证书。

items.meaning: a person who registers
items.meaningCN: 登记者；注册人（-ant 表示行为者）
items.example: Each registrant receives a badge at the door.
items.exampleCN: 每位登记者在门口领取一张胸牌。

items.meaning: officially recorded on a list
items.meaningCN: 已登记的；注册的（-ed 构成形容词）
items.example: It is a registered charity.
items.exampleCN: 这是一个注册慈善机构。

items.meaning: to remove from an official register
items.meaningCN: 注销登记；撤销注册（de- 去除 + register）
items.example: The company deregistered for tax purposes.
items.exampleCN: 这家公司为税务目的注销了登记。

items.meaning: a movement that expresses meaning
items.meaningCN: 手势；姿态（gest- 承载、表演 + -ure）
items.example: He made a small gesture of welcome.
items.exampleCN: 他做了一个小小的欢迎手势。

items.meaning: to bring an idea under someone's notice
items.meaningCN: 建议；暗示（sug- 在下 + gerere 携带，即“带到下面给人看”）
items.example: Her tone suggested that the plan was already agreed.
items.exampleCN: 她的语气暗示这个计划已经谈妥。

items.meaning: to break down and absorb; a summary
items.meaningCN: 消化；摘要（di- 分开 + gerere 携带，即“分开带走”）
items.example: The body digests food slowly at night.
items.exampleCN: 夜间身体消化食物较慢。

latinEntries.structure: neuter plural of regestus, past participle of regerere

definition_zh: 登记；注册；挂号；登记手续；登记记录
definition_en: the act or process of writing down one's name on an official list, or the certificate and record that result
core_image: 在一张官方名册上写下自己的名字：名字落进格子里，格子把它变成一份被承认的存在
scene: 大厅里排着长队，每个人手里都攥着表格和证件。Registration for the new term closes on Friday.
sceneCN: 这里 registration 是「注册；登记」（第 1 个义项：把名字写上官方名单的过程）；句意：新学期注册在周五截止。场景要点：排队的人群、表格、章印。

pos.zh: 登记；注册；挂号；登记手续；登记记录

derivatives.zh: 同根动词，义为「登记；注册；（仪表）显示」
由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「登记者；注册人」
由动词加后缀构成，义为「登记处；登记簿；注册处」
由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「登记员；教务主任；（医院）主治医师助理」

senses.title: The act of putting a name on a list
senses.titleCN: 把名字写上名册的行为
senses.definition: the process of entering a name on an official list, as for school, a conference, or a course
senses.definitionCN: 把名字录入官方名单的过程，如入学、参会或选课
senses.example: Registration for the conference takes place in the main hall.
senses.exampleCN: 大会的登记在主厅进行。
senses.why: The Latin gesta means 'things carried out, written deeds': registration is the writing-down that makes you carried out and counted.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 gesta 意为「已完成之事、写下的事迹」：registration 就是那份让你「被记录、被计入」的写下。

senses.title: Official recording of ownership or status
senses.titleCN: 所有权或身份的官方登记
senses.definition: the official recording of a fact such as who owns a car, land, or company, giving it legal force
senses.definitionCN: 对车辆、土地或公司的归属等事实的官方记录，使其具有法律效力
senses.example: The registration of the car must be renewed every year.
senses.exampleCN: 车辆的登记须每年更新。
senses.why: Writing the fact down gives it a body the law can hold: the record becomes the thing itself.
senses.whyCN: 把事实写下来，就给了法律可以握住的实体：记录本身成了那件事物。

senses.title: The certificate or plate that proves it
senses.titleCN: 证明登记的证件或号牌
senses.definition: the document, number, or plate that shows an entry has been made, as car registration plates
senses.definitionCN: 显示已完成登记的文件、号码或号牌，如汽车登记号牌
senses.example: He checked the registration on the front of the van.
senses.exampleCN: 他核对了面包车前的登记号牌。
senses.why: The written deed is carried about in metal and paper: the record leaves the book and rides on the door.
senses.whyCN: 写下的事迹被带在金属和纸上：记录离开簿册，钉上了车门。

senses.title: The total number of people registered
senses.definition: the number of people or things that have been registered, as school registrations falling this year
senses.definitionCN: 已登记的人数或数量，如今年入学注册人数下降
senses.example: New registrations rose by a fifth last month.
senses.exampleCN: 上个月新增登记量增长了五分之一。
senses.why: The list, once full of names, can be counted: the act becomes a figure in a report.
senses.whyCN: 写满名字的名册可以被清点：行为变成了报告里的一个数字。

intro.en: Registration comes from register, from Latin regesta, past participle of regerere 'to carry back, record', from re- 'back' + gerere 'to carry, carry on, perform'. The register was first the book of things carried back and written down.
intro.cn: registration 来自 register，上溯拉丁语 regesta——regerere「带回、记录」的过去分词，由 re-「回」加 gerere「携带、进行、执行」构成。register 起初是「带回并写下之事」的簿册。

items.en: The reconstructed root *ghes- 'to carry, perform' underlies Latin gerere and its family geste, digest and suggestion.
items.cn: 一般认为重构词根 *ghes-「携带、执行」生出拉丁语 gerere 及其家族 geste、digest、suggestion。

items.en: Regerere meant 'to carry back'; its plural noun regesta meant 'things recorded', the entries an official wrote down and kept.
items.cn: regerere 意为「带回」；其复数名词 regesta 意为「被记录之事」，即官员写下并保存的条目。

items.en: Medieval Latin registrum and Old French registre named the official book itself, kept in courts and chanceries.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 registrum 与古法语 registre 命名了那本官方簿册，存放于法庭与大法官署。

items.en: Register appears in English by the fourteenth century as the book of written entries; the verb follows soon after.
items.cn: register 十四世纪进入英语，指记录条目的簿册；动词很快跟上。

items.en: The action noun registration spreads with modern institutions: schools, elections, motor vehicles and online forms all hold their own lists.
items.cn: 行为名词 registration 随现代制度铺开：学校、选举、机动车与网上表格各有其名册。

note.en: The first group gathers the gerere 'carry out, record' family with its Latin endings. The second group compares the nouns of writing something down and being on a list.
note.cn: 第一组汇集 gerere「执行、记录」词族及其拉丁词尾。第二组比较「写下某事」与「列于名册」的名词。

entries.definition: to enter a name on a list, or the list and book itself. It is the root word.
entries.definitionCN: 把名字录入名册，或名册簿本本身。它是词根词。

entries.definition: the office or system that keeps official lists. It is where the writing-down lives.
entries.definitionCN: 保管官方名册的机构或系统。写下之事安家于此。

entries.definition: the official who keeps the register, at a school, court, or hospital.
entries.definitionCN: 保管名册的官员，见于学校、法院或医院。

entries.definition: the person whose name is written down. The passive member of the family.
entries.definitionCN: 名字被写下的人。词族中的被动一员。

entries.definition: to carry apart and sort out, hence to take apart food or information. Same carrying root, other direction.
entries.definitionCN: 分开搬运整理，引申为消化食物或信息。同一携带词根，方向不同。

entries.definition: the act of joining a school or course and being put on its roll. Enrolment is the joining; registration is the writing.
entries.definitionCN: 加入学校或课程并列入名册的行为。enrolment 重在加入；registration 重在记录。

entries.definition: the American spelling of enrolment, same meaning and same small l.
entries.definitionCN: enrolment 的美式拼写，词义相同。

entries.definition: the casual act of putting one's name down, especially online. It is registration without the office.
entries.definitionCN: 随意的报名，尤指网上。是没有官方机构在场的 registration。

entries.definition: a piece of information kept in writing or sound. Record stores what happened; registration admits you into a list.
entries.definitionCN: 以文字或声音保存的信息。record 储存事实；registration 把你写进名单。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: Latin re- 'back' + gerere 'to carry, carry out', the family register, registrar, registry and digest, and the book-of-deeds picture.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与真实同族词：拉丁语 re-「回」加 gerere「携带、执行」，词族 register、registrar、registry、digest，以及「事迹簿」的图景。

normal.en: re- means back and gerere means carry out: the office carries your name back into its book.
normal.cn: re- 是「回」，gerere 是「执行」：办公室把你的名字带回它的簿册。

normal.en: Gesta, Roman deeds, came from the same verb: a register is a book of gesta.
normal.cn: 罗马人的「事迹」gesta 出自同一动词：register 就是一本事迹簿。

normal.en: The registrar is the person, the registry is the office, the registration is the act.
normal.cn: registrar 是人，registry 是机构，registration 是行为。

normal.en: Digest shares the root: your stomach and your mind both carry things apart to keep them.
normal.cn: digest 同根：胃和头脑都用「分开搬运」来保存事物。

normal.en: A number plate is registration made metal: the list rides on the car door.
normal.cn: 车牌是变成了金属的 registration：名册钉在车门上。

abstract.en: Picture one quiet desk, a ledger, and a pen: your name crossing onto the page is the whole word.
abstract.cn: 想象一张安静的桌子、一本账簿、一支笔：你的名字落上纸页，就是这个词的全部。

abstract.en: Before registration you are a visitor; after it, a line in the book.
abstract.cn: 登记之前你是访客；登记之后，是簿册里的一行字。

abstract.en: Every queue at a desk is people waiting to become records.
abstract.cn: 每一支排队的长龙，都是等待变成记录的人。

examples.en: Bring two photos and your ID to the registration desk.
examples.cn: 请携带两张照片和证件到登记台。

examples.en: Early registration is cheaper than signing up on the day.
examples.cn: 提前注册比当天报名便宜。

examples.en: The land registration office confirmed the sale.
examples.cn: 土地登记处确认了这宗交易。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞记斯追神」——瑞福去登记，斯追着神官盖「记」章 → registration 登记；注册（只借音，不表词源）

root: 源自拉丁语 regesta「被记录之事」（regerere 带回记录：re- 回 + gerere 执行、携带），核心是「把名字或事实带回官方簿册、写成凭证」。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses of registration, all the same written deed: the act of entering the list, the legal record, the proof that travels, and the counted total.
sensesIntro.cn: registration 的四个义项是同一份「写下之事」：录入名册的行为、具有法律效力的记录、可以随行出示的凭证，以及被清点的总数。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a name crossing onto the page of an official book.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个名字落上官方簿册的纸页。

branches.en: THE LIST: entering a name is one act; counting all the entries is the same act read in bulk.
branches.cn: 名册：录入一个名字是一次动作；清点所有条目是把同一动作按整体来读。

branches.en: THE LAW: once written down officially, ownership and status take on legal weight.
branches.cn: 法律：一旦正式写下，所有权与身份便有了法律分量。

branches.en: THE PROOF: plates and certificates carry the book's entry out into the street.
branches.cn: 凭证：号牌与证件把簿册里的条目带到了街上。

branches.en: ONE PEN, TWO POWERS: the same writing-down both admits you and secures your claim.
branches.cn: 一支笔，两种力量：同一次写下既接纳了你，也保全了你的权利。

branches.en: THE RECORD ABROAD: the proof travels and the numbers accumulate, both away from the original book.
branches.cn: 记录在途：凭证在流动，数字在累积，两者都已离开原来的簿册。

intro.en: Registration adds the Latin action suffix -ion to the stem gerere 'to carry, carry out' with the prefix re- 'back'. The gerere family also gives register, registrar, registry, digest and suggest.
intro.cn: registration 在词干 gerere「携带、执行」加前缀 re-「回」之上，附加拉丁行为后缀 -ion。gerere 词族还给出 register、registrar、registry、digest、suggest。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is regerere 'to carry back' (re- 'back' + gerere 'to carry, perform'), whose plural noun regesta means 'things recorded'. Gerere is the same verb behind gesture and suggestion.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语源头是 regerere「带回」（re-「回」+ gerere「携带、执行」），其复数名词 regesta 意为「被记录之事」。gesture 与 suggestion 背后也是这个 gerere。

items.meaning: the act of entering on a list
items.meaningCN: 登记；注册（re- 回 + gerere 执行 + -ion 行为名词）
items.example: Registration closes on Friday.
items.exampleCN: 注册周五截止。

items.meaning: to enter on a list; the official book
items.meaningCN: 登记；名册（经中世纪拉丁语 registrum）
items.example: Register your name at the desk.
items.exampleCN: 在前台登记你的姓名。

items.meaning: the official keeper of a register
items.meaningCN: 登记员；注册主任（-ar 表示官员）
items.example: Ask the registrar for a transcript.
items.exampleCN: 向注册主任要一份成绩单。

items.meaning: the office where lists are kept
items.meaningCN: 登记处；注册处（-y 表示场所）
items.example: The marriage registry issues certificates.
items.exampleCN: 婚姻登记处发放证书。

items.meaning: a person who registers
items.meaningCN: 登记者（-ant 表示被作用的人）
items.example: Each registrant receives a badge.
items.exampleCN: 每位登记者都拿到一枚胸牌。

items.meaning: to separate and take in; a summary
items.meaningCN: 消化；摘要（dis- 分开 + gerere 携带）
items.example: Give me a moment to digest the report.
items.exampleCN: 给我点时间消化这份报告。

items.meaning: to carry an idea under someone's mind; to hint
items.meaningCN: 暗示；建议（sub- 在下 + gerere 携带）
items.example: The data suggests an earlier date.
items.exampleCN: 数据提示年代更早。

items.meaning: a movement of the body that carries meaning
items.meaningCN: 手势；姿态（-ure 构成名词）
items.example: A thumbs-up is a friendly gesture.
items.exampleCN: 竖起拇指是友好的手势。

items.meaning: to pile the story up beyond the truth
items.meaningCN: 夸大；言过其实（ex- 出 + 堆起）
items.example: He exaggerates every difficulty.
items.exampleCN: 他把每个困难都夸大。

items.meaning: the act of joining a school or course
items.meaningCN: 入学注册（英语本土词，与 registration 词源不同而义近）
items.example: Enrolment opens in August.
items.exampleCN: 八月开始报名。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 被记录之事；录下的条目

definition_zh: 后悔；遗憾；惋惜；抱歉；懊悔的事；遗憾的心情
definition_en: to feel sad about something that happened or did not happen, especially something one has done, or the feeling itself
core_image: 回头看向走过的路：手心摊开一样再也拿不回的东西，心往下沉
scene: 搬家那天，他在旧门廊下站了很久，最后只说了句「早知道就常回来了」。She deeply regretted not visiting her grandmother more often.
sceneCN: 这里 regret 是「为未做之事感到后悔」（第 2 个义项：对没有发生的事感到难过）；句意：她深感后悔没有更常去看望祖母。场景要点：老宅门廊、搬空的房间、攥在手里的旧钥匙。

pos.zh: 后悔；遗憾；惋惜
感到后悔；表示歉意
懊悔；遗憾；抱歉；憾事

derivatives.zh: 由名词加形容词后缀构成，义为「懊悔的；遗憾的」（多形容人）
由动词加形容词后缀构成，义为「令人遗憾的；可惜的」（多形容事）
由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「懊悔地；遗憾地」

senses.title: Feel sad about something done
senses.definition: to feel sorrow or disappointment about something one has done or failed to do
senses.definitionCN: 对已做或未做的事感到悲伤或失望
senses.example: He regretted his harsh words almost as soon as he spoke them.
senses.exampleCN: 话一出口他就后悔了自己的刻薄。
senses.why: The root pictures a wailing cry over the past: the cry is grief for what can no longer be undone.
senses.whyCN: 词根画的是对着往事的恸哭：这哭声是为无法挽回之事而发的哀伤。

senses.title: Feel sad about something not done
senses.definition: to feel sorrow about a missed chance or a thing left undone
senses.definitionCN: 为错失的机会或未做之事感到悲伤
senses.example: She deeply regretted not visiting her grandmother more often.
senses.exampleCN: 她深感后悔没有更常去看望祖母。
senses.why: The wail reaches backward over the empty space: the thing mourned never even arrived.
senses.whyCN: 恸哭越过那片空白伸向过去：所哀悼之事甚至从未到来。

senses.title: Say politely that you cannot
senses.definition: to announce politely, with sorrow, that one cannot accept or must refuse, as in I regret to inform you
senses.definitionCN: 带着遗憾礼貌地宣布不能接受或必须拒绝，如 I regret to inform you
senses.example: We regret to inform you that your application was not successful.
senses.exampleCN: 我们遗憾地通知您，申请未能通过。
senses.why: The cry is lowered to a courteous tone: the sadness becomes a formal bow before a refusal.
senses.whyCN: 恸哭被调低为礼貌的语气：悲伤变成了拒绝前的一次正式欠身。

senses.title: The feeling of sorrow itself
senses.definition: the feeling of being sorry about something, as in she felt no regret
senses.definitionCN: 对某事感到难过的心情，如 she felt no regret
senses.example: He left the firm without a trace of regret.
senses.exampleCN: 他离开公司时没有一丝遗憾。
senses.why: The cry becomes an inner possession: sorrow you can carry, weigh, or throw away.
senses.whyCN: 恸哭变成内心的一件所有物：可以背负、掂量或丢弃的哀伤。

senses.title: A thing one is sorry about
senses.definition: a particular thing that one feels sorrow about, especially in the plural, as in his only regrets
senses.definitionCN: 令人感到难过的特定之事，尤以复数形式出现，如 his only regrets
senses.example: Leaving the band is one of her few regrets.
senses.exampleCN: 离开乐队是她为数不多的憾事之一。
senses.why: The sorrow is pinned to an object: each regret is a cry that has found its name.
senses.whyCN: 哀伤被钉在具体对象上：每一件 regret 都是一声找到了名字的哭喊。

senses.title: A polite statement of sorrow
senses.definition: a formal expression of sorrow or apology, as in please accept my regrets
senses.definitionCN: 对悲伤或歉意的正式表达，如 please accept my regrets
senses.example: The embassy sent its official regrets for the delay.
senses.exampleCN: 大使馆为延误发来了正式的歉意表达。
senses.why: The cry, twice formalized, becomes a written card: sorrow dressed in ceremonial clothes.
senses.whyCN: 恸哭经过两度文饰，变成一张书面的卡片：穿上礼服的悲伤。

intro.en: Regret comes from Old French regretter 'to lament, bewail', probably from regreter, literally 'to greet again, look back at', from re- 'again' + greter 'to greet, welcome', itself of Frankish origin. The sense moved from greeting a person back to bewailing the past.
intro.cn: regret 来自古法语 regretter「哀悼、悲叹」，一般认为出自 regreter，字面为「再次迎接、回望」，由 re-「再」加 greter「迎接、问候」构成，greter 源自法兰克语。词义从「迎回一个人」移动到「哀叹往事」。

items.en: Greter descends from the Frankish *grōtōn 'to greet, call out to', related to English greet and Groote in Dutch names. The original act is calling out to someone.
items.cn: greter 源自法兰克语 *grōtōn「问候、喊叫」，与英语 greet、荷兰语人名中的 Groote 相关。最初的动作是向人喊话致意。

items.en: Regreter meant 'to greet again, call back'; it then shifted to 'to bewail the dead, lament a loss' — greeting those who cannot answer.
items.cn: regreter 意为「再次迎接、唤回」；随后转为「哀悼亡者、悲叹损失」——向无法应答之人致意。

items.en: The verb appears in English in the fourteenth century with the sense 'to lament, feel sorrow for'; the spelling settles as regret.
items.cn: 动词十四世纪进入英语，意为「哀叹、为…悲伤」；拼写定型为 regret。

items.en: The noun senses develop: the feeling, the specific thing mourned, and the formal expression of sorrow.
items.cn: 名词诸义发展起来：这种心情、所哀悼的具体之事，以及悲伤的正式表达。

items.en: I regret to inform you fixes the polite usage, and the doubling of the final t in regretted, regretting follows the stress rule of two-syllable verbs.
items.cn: I regret to inform you 确立了礼貌用法；双音节动词按重音规则在构成 regretted、regretting 时双写词尾 t。

note.en: The first group gathers the greet-again family with its derived adjectives. The second group compares the words for sorrow about the past and about the future.
note.cn: 第一组汇集「再致意」词族及其派生形容词。第二组比较「对往事的悲伤」与「对将来的悲伤」两类词。

entries.definition: full of regret, said of people, faces and voices. It is the person wearing the sorrow.
entries.definitionCN: 满怀懊悔的，形容人、表情与声音。是穿着悲伤的人。

entries.definition: deserving regret, said of events and decisions. It is the event that caused the sorrow.
entries.definitionCN: 令人遗憾的，形容事件与决定。是引起悲伤的事件。

entries.definition: either the things one mourns or the polite refusal to an invitation, as in send my regrets.
entries.definitionCN: 既指所憾之事，也指对邀请的婉拒，如 send my regrets。

entries.definition: to welcome someone with words. It is the bare root behind regret: greeting turned backward in time.
entries.definitionCN: 以言语迎接某人。是 regret 背后的朴素词根：被折向过去的问候。

entries.definition: a rowing race, from Italian. Only the spelling is close; no sorrow is involved.
entries.definitionCN: 赛船会，出自意大利语。只是拼写相近，与哀伤无关。

entries.definition: deep regret for doing something wrong. Remorse bites at guilt; regret can mourn a mere chance missed.
entries.definitionCN: 对做过错事的深深懊悔。remorse 叮咬的是罪责；regret 可以只是哀悼错失的机会。

entries.definition: the sorrow for wrongdoing that turns toward change. It adds turning back and mending.
entries.definitionCN: 对过错的悔改。它在悲伤之外增加了回头与弥补。

entries.definition: sadness of any kind. Sorrow is the feeling without direction; regret is sorrow aimed at the past.
entries.definitionCN: 任何一种悲伤。sorrow 是没有方向的悲伤；regret 是瞄准过去的悲伤。

entries.definition: to express grief loudly or in words, or such an expression. Lament speaks the cry; regret can stay silent.
entries.definitionCN: 高声或在言语中表达哀痛，或这种表达。lament 把哭喊说出口；regret 可以一声不响。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: French re- 'again' + greter 'to greet' of Frankish origin, the family greet, regretful and regrettable, and the cry-turned-polite-bow picture.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与真实同族词：法语 re-「再」加法兰克语来源的 greter「致意」，词族 greet、regretful、regrettable，以及「哭喊化为欠身致歉」的图景。

normal.en: regreter means to greet again: you call back to someone who no longer answers.
normal.cn: regreter 意为「再次致意」：你朝一个不再应答的人喊回去。

normal.en: Greet and regret share the root: one greets the future, the other greets the past.
normal.cn: greet 与 regret 同根：一个问候将来，一个问候过去。

normal.en: The verb doubles the t when the stress is final: regretted, regretting.
normal.cn: 重音在末音节时动词双写 t：regretted、regretting。

normal.en: Regretful describes the face; regrettable describes the deed.
normal.cn: regretful 形容那张脸；regrettable 形容那件事。

normal.en: Send my regrets is a greeting turned into a refusal: hello, I cannot come.
normal.cn: send my regrets 是把问候变成了婉拒：你好，我来不了。

abstract.en: Picture a hand raised to wave hello, held in the air over a closed door.
abstract.cn: 想象一只举起要打招呼的手，停在紧闭的门上方。

abstract.en: Regret is the backward wave: the greeting arrives after the person has gone.
abstract.cn: regret 是向后的挥手：问候送到时，人已经走了。

abstract.en: Each regret is a letter addressed to a moment that no longer accepts mail.
abstract.cn: 每一件憾事都是一封寄往不再收信时刻的信。

examples.en: I regret spending so much time on that project.
examples.cn: 我后悔在那个项目上花了那么多时间。

examples.en: Much to my regret, the tickets had sold out.
examples.cn: 令我十分遗憾的是，票已售罄。

examples.en: She said her only regret was never learning to swim.
examples.cn: 她说自己唯一的遗憾是从没学过游泳。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞盖瑞特」——瑞福盖了一座后悔的「阁」，日日夜夜在里面「特」想从前 → regret 后悔；遗憾（只借音，不表词源）

root: 源自古法语 regretter「哀悼、悲叹」（re- 再 + greter 致意，greter 出自法兰克语），核心是「向无法回应的过去再次致意」，即哀叹。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses of regret, one cry heard in three registers: the raw grief for done and undone things, the courteous refusal, and the written card of sorrow.
sensesIntro.cn: regret 的六个义项是同一声哭喊的三种声部：为已做与未做之事的原始哀伤、礼貌的婉拒，以及写成卡片的歉意。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wave hello toward a door that has already closed.
core.cn: 核心意象：朝一扇已经关上的门挥手致意。

chain: WEAR THE SORROW IN THE FACE

branches.en: THE TWO MOURNINGS: things done and things never done are greeted with the same backward call.
branches.cn: 两种哀悼：已做与未做之事，被同一声回望的呼唤致意。

branches.en: COURTESY: the cry is dressed in formal words, refusing invitations and announcing bad news.
branches.cn: 礼节：哭喊穿上正式的言辞，婉拒邀请、通报坏消息。

branches.en: THE FEELING: the sorrow becomes something carried inside, present or absent.
branches.cn: 心情：悲伤成为可以随身携带的东西，可有可无。

branches.en: THE OBJECT: each sorrow finds its name and joins the short list of one's regrets.
branches.cn: 对象：每份悲伤找到自己的名字，加入个人的憾事清单。

branches.en: ACT AND STATE: the verb does the crying, the noun holds what the crying leaves.
branches.cn: 动作与状态：动词在哭，名词盛着哭过之后留下的东西。

intro.en: Regret shows the prefix re- 'again' on greter 'to greet', a French verb of Frankish origin, related to English greet. The family also gives regretful, regrettable and regretfully.
intro.cn: regret 在 greter「致意」上显示前缀 re-「再」；greter 是法语动词，出自法兰克语，与英语 greet 相关。词族还给出 regretful、regrettable、regretfully。

latinIntro.en: Strictly, the root is Germanic rather than Latin: Frankish *grōtōn 'to call out, greet' became Old French greter. English greet is the native doublet of the same call.
latinIntro.cn: 严格说，词根属日耳曼而非拉丁：法兰克语 *grōtōn「喊话、致意」演变为古法语 greter。英语 greet 是同一次喊话的本土孪生词。

items.meaning: to greet the past with sorrow; the sorrow itself
items.meaningCN: 后悔；遗憾（re- 再 + greter 致意）
items.example: You will regret losing that letter.
items.exampleCN: 丢了那封信你会后悔的。

items.meaning: showing sorrow, of people and expressions
items.meaningCN: 懊悔的（-ful 表示充满）
items.example: He gave a regretful smile.
items.exampleCN: 他露出遗憾的微笑。

items.meaning: deserving regret, of events
items.meaningCN: 令人遗憾的（-able 表示应得的）
items.example: The cancellation was deeply regrettable.
items.exampleCN: 取消一事令人深感遗憾。

items.meaning: with sorrow
items.meaningCN: 遗憾地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: Regretfully, we must decline.
items.exampleCN: 很遗憾，我们必须婉拒。

items.meaning: to welcome someone with words
items.meaningCN: 迎接；问候（古英语 grētan，同根）
items.example: She greeted every guest at the door.
items.exampleCN: 她在门口迎接每一位客人。

items.meaning: a word of welcome
items.meaningCN: 问候语（-ing 构成名词）
items.example: The card began with a warm greeting.
items.exampleCN: 卡片以温暖的问候开头。

items.meaning: guilt that bites back
items.meaningCN: 自责；悔恨（出自 mordeRe「咬」，与 regret 词源不同）
items.example: He felt deep remorse for the lie.
items.exampleCN: 他为谎言深感悔恨。

items.meaning: to express grief; an expression of grief
items.meaningCN: 哀叹；挽歌（拉丁 lamenta，与 regret 词源不同）
items.example: The old song laments a vanished village.
items.exampleCN: 这首老歌哀叹一座消失的村庄。

items.meaning: sadness of any kind
items.meaningCN: 悲伤（古英语 sorg，本土词）
items.example: The house was full of sorrow after the news.
items.exampleCN: 消息传来后，全家沉浸在悲伤中。

items.meaning: a formal statement of being sorry
items.meaningCN: 道歉（希腊语 apologia，与 regret 词源不同）
items.example: He sent a written apology to the club.
items.exampleCN: 他向俱乐部递交了书面道歉。

definition_zh: 规则的；定期的；经常的；常规的；正规的；常客；正规成员
definition_en: happening at even intervals, following the usual pattern or rule, or a person who goes somewhere often
core_image: 钟摆按同一刻度来回：每一次落点都相同，被同一根直杆量过
scene: 清晨六点整，早点铺的卷帘门准时哗啦一声卷起，老主顾已经在门口等着了。He is a regular at the corner breakfast stall.
sceneCN: 这里 regular 是「常客」（第 6 个义项：经常光顾某处的人）；句意：他是街角早点摊的常客。场景要点：准时卷起的门帘、热豆浆、老熟人的招呼。

pos.zh: 规则的；定期的；经常的；常规的；正规的；匀称的
常客；正规成员；正规军士兵

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「定期地；经常地；按规律地」
由形容词加名词后缀构成，义为「规律性；匀称」
同根动词，义为「管理；调节；管制」
加否定前缀 ir- 构成，义为「不规则的；不定期的；非正规的」
同根名词，义为「规章；条例；管制」

senses.title: Happening at even intervals
senses.definition: happening again and again with the same space of time between each occurrence
senses.definitionCN: 反复发生，每次之间间隔相同
senses.example: The trains leave at regular intervals of ten minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 列车每十分钟一班，间隔固定。
senses.why: The Latin regula is the straight bar used for measuring: what the bar touches at even distances is regular.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 regula 是量物用的直杆：凡被杆子按相等距离量过的地方，就是 regular。

senses.title: Following the usual pattern
senses.definition: having the usual or expected form, without surprises or exceptions
senses.definitionCN: 具有通常或预期的形式，没有意外或例外
senses.example: He keeps the same regular routine every weekday.
senses.exampleCN: 他每个工作日都保持同样的常规。
senses.why: The bar rules out the crooked: the pattern is straight because it matches the rule.
senses.whyCN: 直杆排除弯曲：模式之所以「直」，是因为它合乎规则。

senses.title: Shaped by perfect symmetry
senses.definition: having all sides, angles, or parts equal or even, as a regular polygon or regular features
senses.definitionCN: 所有边、角或部分相等或均匀，如正多边形或端正的五官
senses.example: A square is the simplest regular polygon.
senses.exampleCN: 正方形是最简单的正多边形。
senses.why: Here the bar measures the shape itself: every side falls exactly on the same length.
senses.whyCN: 这里直杆量的是形状本身：每条边都恰好落在同一长度上。

senses.title: Officially proper or normal
senses.definition: belonging to the proper or official body, not temporary or unofficial, as regular troops or the regular staff
senses.definitionCN: 属于正式或官方编制，而非临时或非官方，如正规军或正式员工
senses.example: The regular army arrived to relieve the volunteers.
senses.exampleCN: 正规军赶来接替了志愿人员。
senses.why: To be on the official list is to be measured by the bar: those who pass the measure are the regulars.
senses.whyCN: 名列官方名册就是被直杆量过：量得合格者便是 regular。

senses.title: Ordinary, without special strength
senses.definition: of the normal size, strength, or kind, as a regular coffee or a regular petrol engine
senses.definitionCN: 指正常大小、浓度或类型，如普通咖啡或标准汽油发动机
senses.example: Just a regular coffee, no sugar.
senses.exampleCN: 一杯普通的咖啡，不加糖。
senses.why: The bar finds nothing over or under the line: the thing sits at the standard measure.
senses.whyCN: 直杆量出既不超标也不不足：此物恰在标准刻度上。

senses.title: A person who goes often
senses.definition: a customer, visitor, or member who attends a place often and is known there
senses.definitionCN: 经常光顾某处、为人熟知的顾客、访客或成员
senses.example: The barman sets aside a stool for his regulars.
senses.exampleCN: 酒保为常客们留着固定的凳子。
senses.why: The even intervals become habit: the person whose visits the bar could measure like clockwork.
senses.whyCN: 均匀的间隔变成习惯：这个人的到访准得像被钟摆量过。

senses.title: A soldier of the standing army
senses.definition: a member of the permanent professional army, not a reserve or volunteer
senses.definitionCN: 常备职业军队的成员，而非预备役或志愿兵
senses.example: The regulars held the bridge until reinforcements came.
senses.exampleCN: 正规军士兵坚守桥梁直到援兵到来。
senses.why: The official measure of sense four applied to a uniform: the soldier who is always on the list.
senses.whyCN: 第四义「官方名册」套到军装上：永远在编制名单上的士兵。

intro.en: Regular comes from Old French reguler, from Latin regularis, from regula 'a straight bar, a rule, a pattern', itself from regere 'to keep straight, guide'. The ruler and the ruler's bar are the same tool in two hands.
intro.cn: regular 来自古法语 reguler，上溯拉丁语 regularis，出自 regula「直杆、规则、模范」，regula 又源自 regere「保持笔直、引导」。统治者的「规矩」与木匠的「直杆」，是同一件工具握在两只手里。

items.en: The root *h3reg- 'to move straight, direct' underlies regere, and English right, reckon and rich. Straightness, correctness and wealth (the guiding hand) share one root.
items.cn: 词根 *h3reg-「直线行进、引导」是 regere 的来源；英语 right、reckon、rich 同根。笔直、正确与财富（引导之手）出自同一个根。

items.en: Regula meant a carpenter's straight edge and, by extension, any rule or pattern; regularis meant 'having the bar in it, according to rule'. Monastic regularis clergy lived under the rule of an order.
items.cn: regula 既指木匠的直尺，也引申指任何规则或范本；regularis 意为「依规而行的」。修道院的 regularis clergy 即「依会规生活的神职人员」。

items.en: Reguler passes into English in the late fourteenth century as reguler, at first of religious rule and lawful order.
items.cn: reguler 于十四世纪晚期以 reguler 的形式进入英语，最初指宗教规诫与合法秩序。

items.en: The senses spread from religion to grammar, geometry and the army: regular verbs, regular polygons, regular troops.
items.cn: 词义从宗教扩散到语法、几何与军队：规则动词、正多边形、正规部队。

items.en: The noun regular, for habitual customers and standing soldiers, grows out of the adjective in everyday speech.
items.cn: 名词 regular 指常客与常备兵，由形容词在日常语言中生长出来。

note.en: The first group gathers the regula 'straight bar' family with its negation. The second group compares the words for steady and for normal.
note.cn: 第一组汇集 regula「直杆」词族及其否定形式。第二组比较「稳定」与「正常」两类词。

entries.definition: not regular: uneven, unlawful, or off the list. The bar finds nothing straight.
entries.definitionCN: 不规则的；不定期的；非正规的。直杆量不出笔直。

entries.definition: at even intervals, again and again. It is the adjective keeping time.
entries.definitionCN: 定期地；经常地。是形容词在打拍子。

entries.definition: to keep something straight by rule, to control it. The bar applied to systems.
entries.definitionCN: 用规则管制。直杆被用在体系上。

entries.definition: an official rule, or the act of controlling. The bar written down as law.
entries.definitionCN: 规章；管制。直杆被写成法律。

entries.definition: a system of rule, of a country or a body. The bar held as reins.
entries.definitionCN: 政权；管理体制；方案。直杆被当作缰绳握着。

entries.definition: happening at fixed periods. Periodic names the clock; regular names the evenness it produces.
entries.definitionCN: 按固定周期发生。periodic 命名时钟；regular 命名它产生的均匀。

entries.definition: happening often, but not necessarily at even intervals. Frequent counts; regular measures.
entries.definitionCN: 经常发生，但间隔未必均匀。frequent 数次数；regular 量间隔。

entries.definition: as expected, usual. Normal is the statistical middle; regular is the rule that is kept.
entries.definitionCN: 如预期般的平常。normal 是统计上的中间值；regular 是被遵守的规则。

entries.definition: done by habit. Habitual is inside the person; regular is measurable from outside.
entries.definitionCN: 习惯性的。habitual 在人的内心；regular 从外部即可量得。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: Latin regula 'a straight bar' from regere 'to keep straight', the family irregular, regularly, regulate and regulation, and the carpenter's bar that measures everything even.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与真实同族词：拉丁语 regula「直杆」（出自 regere「保持笔直」），词族 irregular、regularly、regulate、regulation，以及丈量一切「均匀」的木匠直尺。

normal.en: regula is the straight bar: whatever it measures at even distances is regular.
normal.cn: regula 是直杆：凡被它按相等距离量过的，就是 regular。

normal.en: Rule, ruler and regular all carry the same Latin bar: one is the law, one the measuring tool, one the result.
normal.cn: rule、ruler、regular 都带着同一根拉丁直杆：一个是法律，一个是量具，一个是结果。

normal.en: The prefix ir- is the Latin in- before r: irregular is simply not-measured-straight.
normal.cn: 前缀 ir- 是拉丁 in- 在 r 前的变形：irregular 就是「没量直」。

normal.en: A regular polygon has every side cut to the same length by the invisible bar.
normal.cn: 正多边形的每条边都被那把看不见的直杆裁成同一长度。

normal.en: A regular at a shop is a person whose visits the bar could have timed.
normal.cn: 商店的常客，就是到访时间仿佛被直杆量过的人。

abstract.en: Picture a metronome ticking with no drum beat to follow, perfectly even on its own.
abstract.cn: 想象一台节拍器，不跟任何鼓点，自己走得完全均匀。

abstract.en: Straightness is quiet: nothing deviates, so nothing calls attention to itself.
abstract.cn: 笔直是安静的：没有任何偏离，也就没有任何东西引人注意。

abstract.en: The bar never praises, it only approves: everything equal, everything regular.
abstract.cn: 直杆从不赞美，它只作核准：处处相等，处处规则。

examples.en: Take the medicine at regular intervals of six hours.
examples.cn: 每六小时定期服药一次。

examples.en: The garden needs regular watering through the dry weeks.
examples.cn: 干旱的几周里，花园需要定期浇水。

examples.en: Most of the tables were kept for the regulars.
examples.cn: 大多数座位都留给了常客。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞古乐」——瑞福「古」板又「乐」在其中：天天按规矩来，定时也定心 → regular 规律的；定期的；常客（只借音，不表词源）

root: 源自拉丁语 regula「直杆；规则」（regere 引直），核心是「被直杆量过、处处均匀、合乎规矩」。

sensesIntro.en: Seven senses of regular, all one bar applied again and again: to time, to shape, to the official list, to strength, and finally to the person who returns at the same hour.
sensesIntro.cn: regular 的七个义项是同一根直杆的反复应用：量时间、量形状、量官方名册、量浓度，最后量那个总在同一时刻回来的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a straight bar touching everything at the same, even measure.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根直杆以相同、均匀的刻度触及一切。

chain: CUT EVERY SIDE TO THE SAME LENGTH
KEEP TO THE RULE WITHOUT EXCEPTION
RETURN AT THE SAME HOUR ALWAYS

branches.en: TIME AND DEGREE: trains and coffee alike sit on the bar's standard marks.
branches.cn: 时间与浓度：列车与咖啡同样落在直杆的标准刻度上。

branches.en: PATTERN AND SHAPE: behaviour and geometry both avoid the crooked line.
branches.cn: 模式与形状：行为与几何都避开弯曲的线。

branches.en: THE OFFICIAL LIST: troops on the permanent roll are regulars in uniform.
branches.cn: 官方名册：常备编制里的军人，就是穿军装的 regular。

branches.en: THE PERSON: the even intervals settle into a familiar face at the counter.
branches.cn: 人：均匀的间隔沉淀成柜台上的一张熟面孔。

branches.en: RULE AND HABIT: what the rule demands of systems, the habit performs in a person.
branches.cn: 规则与习惯：规则对体系的要求，由习惯在个人身上完成。

intro.en: Regular adds the Latin adjective ending -aris / -ar to regula 'a straight bar, a rule', from regere 'to keep straight'. The negated ir- is the Latin in- shifting before r.
intro.cn: regular 在 regula「直杆、规则」（出自 regere「保持笔直」）上添加拉丁形容词词尾 -aris／-ar。否定前缀 ir- 是拉丁 in- 在 r 前的音变。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is regularis 'according to the regula', where regula is the carpenter's bar and, by extension, any rule. The regula bar also gives rule, ruler and regulus, the little king of the bird world.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语源头是 regularis「依 regula 而行」，regula 是木匠的直尺，引申指任何规则。regula 还给出 rule、ruler 以及戴菊莺（regulus，鸟界的「小王」）。

items.meaning: measured even; by rule; a habitual visitor
items.meaningCN: 规律的；常规的；常客（-ar 构成形容词）
items.example: He kept regular hours all his life.
items.exampleCN: 他一辈子作息规律。

items.meaning: at even intervals
items.meaningCN: 定期地；按规律地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The meters are checked regularly.
items.exampleCN: 仪表定期接受检查。

items.meaning: not even or lawful
items.meaningCN: 不规则的；非正规的（ir- 表否定）
items.example: An irregular heartbeat needs checking.
items.exampleCN: 心律不齐需要检查。

items.meaning: the quality of being even and steady
items.meaningCN: 规律性；均匀（-ity 构成性质名词）
items.example: The clock impressed him with its regularity.
items.exampleCN: 这座钟的规律令他叹服。

items.meaning: to control by rule
items.meaningCN: 管制；调节（-ate 构成动词）
items.example: Sweat regulates body temperature.
items.exampleCN: 出汗调节体温。

items.meaning: an official rule; the act of controlling
items.meaningCN: 规章；管制（-ion 构成名词）
items.example: Safety regulations apply to all workshops.
items.exampleCN: 安全规章适用于所有车间。

items.meaning: a law of conduct; to govern
items.meaningCN: 规则；统治（经古法语 riule）
items.example: House rules apply to everyone.
items.exampleCN: 家规对每个人都适用。

items.meaning: one who governs; the measuring bar itself
items.meaningCN: 统治者；直尺（-er 表示人或物）
items.example: Draw the line with a ruler.
items.exampleCN: 用直尺画这条线。

items.meaning: the little king; a small bird, the goldcrest
items.meaningCN: 小王；戴菊莺（-ulus 表示小）
items.example: A regulus flitted through the pines.
items.exampleCN: 一只戴菊莺掠过松林。

items.meaning: as expected, usual
items.meaningCN: 正常的（出自 norma「矩尺」，与 regular 词源不同而义近）
items.example: Nothing about the day was normal.
items.exampleCN: 这一天没有任何地方是正常的。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 依规而行的；合乎规则的

latinEntries.meaning: a straight bar; a rule, pattern
to keep straight, to guide, to rule

definition_zh: 定期地；经常地；按规律地；均匀地；正式地
definition_en: again and again at even intervals, in a steady pattern, or in the usual proper way
core_image: 节拍器不间断地摆动：每一次摆动都落在同一个刻度上，从不迟到也从不抢拍
scene: 小区里那位老人每天六点整出现在湖边，风雪无阻，四十年了。He visits the lake library regularly to read the newspapers.
sceneCN: 这里 regularly 是「定期地；经常地」（第 1 个义项：按均匀间隔反复发生）；句意：他定期去湖畔图书馆读报。场景要点：清晨的湖、固定的座位、翻旧了的报纸。

pos.zh: 定期地；经常地；按规律地；均匀地；正式地

derivatives.zh: 同根形容词，义为「规律的；定期的；常规的」
加否定前缀构成，义为「不规则地；不定期地」
同根名词，义为「规律性；均匀」
同根动词，义为「管理；调节」

senses.title: Again and again at even intervals
senses.definition: happening again and again with the same amount of time between each occasion
senses.definitionCN: 反复发生，且每次之间间隔的时间相等
senses.example: The committee meets regularly on the first Monday of each month.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会每月第一个周一定期开会。
senses.why: The bar of regula touches time at equal marks: each event lands on the same tick.
senses.whyCN: regula 的直杆以相等的刻度触及时间：每个事件都落在同一格上。

senses.title: In a steady, even pattern
senses.definition: in a way that has an even pattern, spacing, or rhythm, without irregularity
senses.definitionCN: 以均匀的样式、间距或节奏进行，毫无凌乱
senses.example: The regularly spaced windows give the tower its calm look.
senses.exampleCN: 间距均匀的窗户赋予塔楼沉静的气质。
senses.why: The bar is laid over space here: every window sits on the same line.
senses.whyCN: 这里直杆量的是空间：每扇窗都落在同一条线上。

senses.title: Often, as a settled habit
senses.definition: often, as part of an established habit or programme
senses.definitionCN: 频繁地，作为已确立的习惯或安排的一部分
senses.example: He regularly forgets his umbrella, and regularly complains about it.
senses.exampleCN: 他经常忘带伞，也经常为此抱怨。
senses.why: The even marks become habit when they are kept again and again: the tick turns into a trait.
senses.whyCN: 均匀的刻度被一次次遵守便成了习惯：钟摆的一格变成了性格的一笔。

senses.title: In the normal proper way
senses.definition: in the usual, correct, or officially proper manner
senses.definitionCN: 以通常、正确或官方正当的方式进行
senses.example: The goods were regularly imported, with all duties paid.
senses.exampleCN: 货物是正规进口的，关税全数缴清。
senses.why: The bar approves what passes over it: passing the measure is being regular.
senses.whyCN: 直杆核准从它上面通过之物：通过量度即是正规。

intro.en: Regularly is the adverb of regular, from Latin regularis, from regula 'a straight bar, a rule', from regere 'to keep straight, guide'. The suffix -ly turns the bar's measure into a manner of happening.
intro.cn: regularly 是 regular 的副词形式，regular 出自拉丁语 regularis，上溯 regula「直杆、规则」，regula 又出自 regere「保持笔直、引导」。后缀 -ly 把直杆的量度变成事情发生的方式。

items.en: The root *h3reg- 'to straighten, direct' underlies regere and its English cousins right, reckon and rich.
items.cn: 词根 *h3reg-「拉直、引导」是 regere 的来源；英语 right、reckon、rich 与之同根。

items.en: Regula named the carpenter's straight edge and any rule; regularis meant 'according to the rule'. The adverb could not exist in Latin; manner had to be said with phrases.
items.cn: regula 指木匠的直尺及一切规则；regularis 意为「依规而行」。拉丁语没有现成副词，方式须用短语表达。

items.era: OLD FRENCH AND MIDDLE ENGLISH, 14TH C.
items.en: Reguler enters English as the adjective; the adverb regularly appears soon after, built with the native -ly ending.
items.cn: reguler 以形容词身份进入英语；副词 regularly 随即出现，配上了本土的 -ly 词尾。

items.en: The adverb spreads from religious observance to clocks, trains, publishing and medicine: whatever repeats can be said to happen regularly.
items.cn: 副词从宗教操守扩散到钟表、铁路、出版与医学：凡重复之事皆可言 regularly。

items.en: The phrase exercise regularly fixed the health sense, and the ironic use of regularly for annoying habits gives it a light conversational tone.
items.cn: exercise regularly 确立了健康义；regularly 反讽地用于恼人的习惯，让它带上轻松的会话语气。

note.en: The first group gathers the regula family and its negation. The second group compares the adverbs of repetition and steadiness.
note.cn: 第一组汇集 regula 词族及其否定形式。第二组比较「重复」与「稳定」两类副词。

entries.definition: even and rule-keeping, said of things and people. It is the adjective the adverb leans on.
entries.definitionCN: 规律的；常客。是副词所依托的形容词。

entries.definition: at uneven intervals or in an unlawful way. The bar finds nothing even.
entries.definitionCN: 不规则地；非正式地。直杆量不出均匀。

entries.definition: an official rule. When something is done regularly by law, a regulation stands behind it.
entries.definitionCN: 规章。凡依法定期进行之事，背后必有一条 regulation。

entries.definition: a system of rule or a planned routine. The bar held as reins.
entries.definitionCN: 政权；体制；训练方案。直杆被当作缰绳握着。

entries.definition: to keep something even by rule. The verb that makes the adverb true.
entries.definitionCN: 用规则管制。让这个副词成立的动词。

entries.definition: at fixed periods. It names the clock's cycle; regularly names the evenness kept within it.
entries.definitionCN: 周期性地。periodically 命名时钟的周期；regularly 命名其中保持的均匀。

entries.definition: often, without implying even spacing. Frequently counts visits; regularly measures them.
entries.definitionCN: 频繁地，不含间隔均匀之意。frequently 数次数；regularly 量间隔。

entries.definition: by settled habit. It points inward to the person's pattern; regularly points to the outside clock.
entries.definitionCN: 习惯性地。habitually 指向人的内在模式；regularly 指向外在的钟摆。

entries.definition: all the time, without stopping. Constantly removes the gaps; regularly measures them.
entries.definitionCN: 持续不断地。constantly 消除了间隔；regularly 量着间隔。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: Latin regula 'a straight bar' from regere 'to keep straight', the suffix -ly for manner, the family irregularly, regulation and regulate.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与真实同族词：拉丁语 regula「直杆」（出自 regere「保持笔直」），方式副词后缀 -ly，词族 irregularly、regulation、regulate。

normal.en: Regular plus -ly: the bar's even measure turned into a way of happening.
normal.cn: regular 加 -ly：直杆的均匀量度变成了事情发生的方式。

normal.en: The -ly ending is the native English way to make adverbs, as in quick, quickly.
normal.cn: -ly 是英语本土的副词后缀，如 quick 变 quickly。

normal.en: Irregularly simply denies the even marks: the ticks fall where they like.
normal.cn: irregularly 只是否定均匀的刻度：钟点随心所欲地落。

normal.en: Regularly scheduled means the timetable was set by the invisible bar.
normal.cn: regularly scheduled 意为时刻表由那根看不见的直杆排定。

normal.en: He regularly forgets his umbrella: even his mistakes keep perfect time.
normal.cn: 他经常忘带伞：连他的失误都守着准点。

abstract.en: Picture rain falling on a drum skin, each drop landing exactly one second after the last.
abstract.cn: 想象雨点落在鼓面上，每一滴都恰好比上一滴晚一秒。

abstract.en: Regularity is the quietest kind of beauty: nothing deviates, so the eye can rest.
abstract.cn: 规律是最安静的美：没有任何偏离，眼睛得以休息。

abstract.en: A habit is a clock you build inside yourself and then obey.
abstract.cn: 习惯是你装在自己体内的钟，装好之后还得服从它。

examples.en: She writes to her old teacher regularly, twice a month.
examples.cn: 她定期给老教师写信，每月两封。

examples.en: The lamps are cleaned regularly to keep the street bright.
examples.cn: 路灯定期清洁，以保持街道明亮。

examples.en: The pills must be taken regularly, not just when you feel ill.
examples.cn: 药必须按时服用，不能只在难受时才吃。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞古乐利」——瑞福古板却有「利」于健康：定期锻炼，从不间断 → regularly 定期地；经常地（只借音，不表词源）

root: 源自拉丁语 regula「直杆；规则」（regere 引直）加副词后缀 -ly，核心是「按直杆的均匀刻度反复发生」。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses of regularly, one even tick applied to time, to space, to habit, and to law.
sensesIntro.cn: regularly 的四个义项是同一声均匀的钟摆，分别作用于时间、空间、习惯与法律。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tick that always lands on the same mark, in time or in space.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个总是落在同一刻度上的钟点，无论在时间还是空间里。

branches.en: TIME AND HABIT: even intervals kept long enough become a person's routine.
branches.cn: 时间与习惯：均匀间隔被长期遵守，便化作一个人的日常。

branches.en: SPACE: the same evenness laid over windows, teeth and lamps.
branches.cn: 空间：同样的均匀铺在窗户、齿轮与路灯上。

branches.en: LAW: what the rule approves is done regularly, in the proper way.
branches.cn: 法律：经规则核准之事，即为正规地进行。

branches.en: ONE BAR, TWO DIMENSIONS: the straight edge measures both the clock and the wall.
branches.cn: 一杆两用：同一根直尺既量时钟，也量墙壁。

branches.en: INSIDE AND OUTSIDE: the settled habit is personal; the proper manner is official.
branches.cn: 内与外：固定的习惯属于个人；正当的方式属于官方。

intro.en: Regularly builds on regular with the native adverb suffix -ly; regular itself is regula 'a straight bar' with the Latin adjective ending. The negated form irregularly uses the shifted prefix ir-.
intro.cn: regularly 由 regular 加本土副词后缀 -ly 构成；regular 本身是 regula「直杆」加拉丁形容词词尾。否定形式 irregularly 使用音变后的前缀 ir-。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is regularis 'according to the regula', the carpenter's straight bar that became the very idea of a rule. Regere 'to keep straight' is the verb behind the bar.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语源头是 regularis「依 regula 而行」，regula 是木匠的直尺，后来成为「规则」观念本身。直尺背后的动词是 regere「保持笔直」。

items.meaning: at even intervals; as a habit; properly
items.meaningCN: 定期地；经常地；正规地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: Water the plants regularly in summer.
items.exampleCN: 夏天要定期给植物浇水。

items.meaning: even, by rule; a habitual visitor
items.meaningCN: 规律的；常客（-ar 构成形容词）
items.example: He is a regular volunteer here.
items.exampleCN: 他是这里的固定志愿者。

items.meaning: at uneven intervals
items.meaningCN: 不规则地；不定时地（ir- 表否定）
items.example: The buses run irregularly on holidays.
items.exampleCN: 节假日公交车班次不定。

items.meaning: evenness; steadiness of pattern
items.meaningCN: 规律性；均匀（-ity 构成性质名词）
items.example: The regularity of the tides aids navigation.
items.exampleCN: 潮汐的规律利于航行。

items.meaning: to keep even by rule
items.meaningCN: 调节；管制（-ate 构成动词）
items.example: A thermostat regulates the room temperature.
items.exampleCN: 恒温器调节室温。

items.meaning: an official rule
items.meaningCN: 规章（-ion 构成名词）
items.example: Wear goggles: that is a site regulation.
items.exampleCN: 戴护目镜，这是工地规章。

items.meaning: at fixed periods
items.meaningCN: 周期性地（出自希腊语 periodos「环绕一周」，与 regularly 词源不同）
items.example: The system updates periodically overnight.
items.exampleCN: 系统在夜间周期性更新。

items.meaning: in most cases
items.meaningCN: 通常（出自拉丁 usus「使用」，与 regularly 词源不同）
items.example: The shop usually opens at eight.
items.exampleCN: 这家店通常八点开门。

items.meaning: in most cases; broadly
items.meaningCN: 一般地；总体上（出自拉丁 genus「种类」）
items.example: Generally, the trains are punctual.
items.exampleCN: 总体而言，列车很准时。

items.meaning: in a steady way
items.meaningCN: 稳定地（拉丁 stabilis「牢固的」）
items.example: Prices have remained stably low this year.
items.exampleCN: 今年物价稳定保持在低位。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 依规而行的；合乎规则的

definition_zh: 规章；规则；管理；调控；调节
definition_en: an official rule, or the act of controlling and adjusting how something operates
core_image: 一只调速器在蒸汽机上方旋转，把过快的轮子压回稳定转速
scene: 工厂里贴出新通知：排放数据必须定期上报。New regulation requires factories to report their emissions every quarter.
sceneCN: 这里 regulation 指「具有约束力的规章」（第 1 个义项：官方制定的规则）；句意：新规章要求工厂每月报告排放。图中可辨识物件：法规文本、印章、排放烟囱、月度报表。

pos.zh: 规章；规则；管理；调控；（生物）调节；（欧洲联盟法）条例

derivatives.zh: 管理；调节；控制
监管的；规章的
监管者；调节器
放松管制

senses.title: An official rule
senses.titleCN: 官方规章：具有约束力的规则
senses.definition: a rule made by a government or authority and binding on those it covers
senses.definitionCN: 由政府或主管机构制定、对其覆盖对象具有约束力的规则
senses.example: New regulation requires factories to report emissions every month.
senses.exampleCN: 新规章要求工厂每月报告排放。
senses.why: Regulation comes from Latin regula 'rule, straight stick', the same measure used to keep a line true; a rule keeps behaviour straight.
senses.whyCN: regulation 出自拉丁 regula「规则、直木条」，即用来把线画直的量尺；规则的作用正是把行为「拉直」。

senses.title: Government oversight
senses.titleCN: 政府监管：对行业的持续管理
senses.definition: the continuing supervision of an industry or activity by public authorities
senses.definitionCN: 公共机关对某一行业或活动的持续监督
senses.example: Banking regulation grew stricter after the crisis.
senses.exampleCN: 危机之后，银行业监管变得更严格。
senses.why: The noun shifts from a single rule to the whole activity of ruling: issuing, monitoring and enforcing rules.
senses.whyCN: 名词从「一条规则」转向「治理活动整体」：制定、监督与执行规则。

senses.title: Biological regulation
senses.titleCN: 生物调节：身体维持内环境稳定
senses.definition: in biology, the processes by which an organism keeps internal conditions within a workable range
senses.definitionCN: 生物学中生物把内部状态维持在可运作范围内的过程
senses.example: Body temperature regulation depends on sweating and blood flow.
senses.exampleCN: 体温调节依赖出汗与血流。
senses.why: Life uses the same controlling image: feedback loops keep a variable near a set point, just as a governor keeps a wheel steady.
senses.whyCN: 生命沿用同一个控制意象：反馈环路把某个变量维持在设定点附近，如同调速器让轮子稳定。

senses.title: Gene regulation
senses.titleCN: 基因调控：决定哪个基因何时开启
senses.definition: in molecular biology, the control of when and how strongly a gene is expressed
senses.definitionCN: 分子生物学中控制基因何时表达以及表达强弱的机制
senses.example: Gene regulation explains why two cells with the same DNA behave differently.
senses.exampleCN: 基因调控解释了为何 DNA 相同的两个细胞行为不同。
senses.why: The controlling image narrows to molecular switches: binding sites decide whether the machinery can read a gene.
senses.whyCN: 控制意象收窄到分子开关：结合位点决定读取基因的机器能否开工。

senses.title: Emotional regulation
senses.titleCN: 情绪调节：管理自己的情绪反应
senses.definition: in psychology, the ability to monitor and adjust one's emotional responses
senses.definitionCN: 心理学中监控并调整自身情绪反应的能力
senses.example: Children learn emotional regulation by naming what they feel.
senses.exampleCN: 儿童通过给感受命名来学习情绪调节。
senses.why: Psychology borrows the control metaphor for the inner state: a feeling is treated as a variable that can be adjusted rather than merely suffered.
senses.whyCN: 心理学把控制隐喻用于内在状态：情绪被当作可调变量，而不只是被动承受之物。

senses.title: Technical control
senses.titleCN: 技术调节：让设备保持在设定值
senses.definition: the automatic or manual adjustment of a machine, flow or temperature to keep it at a set level
senses.definitionCN: 自动或手动调整机器、流量或温度，使其保持在设定水平
senses.example: The valve provides fine regulation of the water flow.
senses.exampleCN: 该阀门对水流进行精细调节。
senses.why: This is the most literal sense: a device measures the deviation and corrects it, keeping the process regular.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项最字面：装置测量偏差并加以纠正，使过程保持「有规律」。

senses.title: Rules of a sport
senses.titleCN: 体育规则：比赛所依的规约
senses.definition: the official rules of a sport, or the standard period of play before extra time
senses.definitionCN: 体育项目的正式规则，或加时赛之前的常规比赛时段
senses.example: The match ended in regulation time, so no extra period was needed.
senses.exampleCN: 比赛在常规时间内结束，因此无需加时。
senses.why: Sports borrowed the legal noun: the game is governed by rules, and the unextended match is played within them.
senses.whyCN: 体育借用了法律名词：比赛由规则治理，未加时的比赛就是在规则时段内完成的。

senses.title: An EU legal instrument
senses.titleCN: 欧盟条例：直接适用于成员国的立法形式
senses.definition: in European Union law, a binding legislative act that applies directly in all member states
senses.definitionCN: 欧盟法中直接适用于所有成员国的有约束力立法行为
senses.example: The regulation took effect in every member state on the same day.
senses.exampleCN: 该条例同一天在所有成员国生效。
senses.why: Legal systems distinguish kinds of instrument, and the EU gives the general word regulation a precise status: binding, general and directly applicable.
senses.whyCN: 法律体系区分不同立法工具，欧盟给一般词 regulation 一个精确地位：有约束力、普遍适用且直接生效。

intro.en: Regulation comes from Latin regulatio, the noun of action from regulare 'to rule, direct', built on regula 'rule, straight stick'. The English word covers both a rule and the act of keeping something steady.
intro.cn: regulation 出自拉丁 regulatio，即 regulare「管理、引导」的动作名词，而 regulare 基于 regula「规则、直木条」。英语词同时涵盖「规则」与「使某物保持稳定」的动作。

items.en: Regula meant a rule or a straight piece of wood used to check a line. It is generally linked to regere 'to rule, guide straight', though the exact derivational path is uncertain.
items.cn: regula 指规则，也指用来校验直线的直木条。它一般认为与 regere「统治、引直」相关，但确切的派生路径存疑。

items.en: The verb regulare meant 'to direct by rule, to regulate'. Classical writers used it for controlling conduct and, later, for adjusting instruments.
items.cn: 动词 regulare 意为「按规则引导、调节」。古典作者用它指控制行为，后来也用于调整器械。

items.en: Late Latin regulatio named the act of regulating. The noun passed into French and then English with the sense of rule-governed order.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁 regulatio 指「调节、管理」的动作。该名词经法语进入英语，带有「依规则而形成的秩序」之义。

items.en: By the seventeenth century regulation commonly meant an authoritative rule, especially in military and administrative contexts.
items.cn: 到 17 世纪，regulation 常指权威性规则，尤见于军事与行政语境。

items.en: Engineering and biology kept the older active sense: a governor or feedback loop regulates speed, temperature or gene expression.
items.cn: 工程与生物学保留了较早的主动义：调速器或反馈环路调节速度、温度或基因表达。

items.en: The exact first English citation is uncertain, and the link between regula and regere is generally accepted rather than fully documented.
items.cn: 来源不确定（派生路径）：英语最早书证确切年代存疑；regula 与 regere 的联系属于「一般认为是」，并非完全有文献可证。

note.en: The first group separates the regulate family; the second gives near-synonyms for rules and for control.
note.cn: 第一组区分 regulate 词族；第二组给出关于规则与控制的近义词。

entries.definition: To control or adjust. Regulation is the rule or the act as a noun.
entries.definitionCN: 指控制或调节；regulation 是规则或作为名词的动作。

entries.definition: An official agency or a mechanical device that regulates. It is the doer, not the rule.
entries.definitionCN: 指监管机构或调节装置；是施动者，不是规则。

entries.definition: Describing what relates to regulation. It modifies nouns such as agency or framework.
entries.definitionCN: 形容与监管相关，修饰 agency、framework 等名词。

entries.definition: The imposition of strict, often military-style order. It carries a negative tone that regulation need not have.
entries.definitionCN: 指强加严格、常为军事化的秩序，带贬义，而 regulation 未必有贬义。

entries.definition: A stated instruction about what may or must be done. A regulation is usually official and backed by an authority.
entries.definitionCN: 指关于可为或必为的明确指示；regulation 通常由官方制定并有权威支撑。

entries.definition: A formal statute enacted by a legislature. A regulation is often made under a law by an agency.
entries.definitionCN: 指立法机关通过的正式法律；regulation 常由行政机关依法制定。

entries.definition: The exercise of power to direct behaviour or a process. It is broader and does not imply written rules.
entries.definitionCN: 指引导行为或过程的权力运用，范围更广，不暗示成文规则。

entries.definition: Oversight by someone with authority. It stresses monitoring rather than issuing rules.
entries.definitionCN: 指有权威者的监督，强调监视而非制定规则。

entries.definition: A small change made to fit a condition. It matches the technical sense but lacks the sense of sustained control.
entries.definitionCN: 指为适应情况所做的小改动；与技术义相合，但缺少持续控制之意。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: regula 'straight stick' + -ation: keeping behaviour on a straight line.
normal.cn: regula「直木条」+ -ation：让行为保持在直线上。

normal.en: The family runs regulate, regulator, regulatory, deregulation, rule.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 regulate、regulator、regulatory、deregulation、rule。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: government regulation, gene regulation, emotional regulation, regulation time.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：政府监管、基因调控、情绪调节、常规比赛时间。

normal.en: In biology, feedback keeps a variable near a set point, exactly like a governor.
normal.cn: 生物学中，反馈让变量保持在设定点附近，正如调速器。

normal.en: In EU law, a regulation is binding and directly applicable, unlike a directive.
normal.cn: 欧盟法中，条例有约束力并直接适用，与指令不同。

abstract.en: Picture a governor spinning on top of an engine, opening and closing as speed changes.
abstract.cn: 想象调速器在发动机上方旋转，随速度变化开合。

abstract.en: Picture a ruler laid along a drawn line to check that it has not bent.
abstract.cn: 想象一把直尺贴着画好的线，检查它是否弯曲。

abstract.en: Picture a thermostat nudging a needle back to the marked number.
abstract.cn: 想象恒温器把指针推回标定的数字。

examples.en: The agency issued a regulation on aircraft noise at night.
examples.cn: 该机构发布了关于夜间飞机噪声的规章。

examples.en: Gene regulation decides which proteins a cell makes and when.
examples.cn: 基因调控决定细胞制造哪些蛋白质以及何时制造。

examples.en: The governor provides regulation of engine speed under load.
examples.cn: 调速器在负荷下调节发动机转速。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「regular（有规律的）+ tion」——让一切按规矩来 → regulation 规章、调节

root: 拉丁 regula「规则、直木条」→ regulare「按规则管理、调节」→ regulatio；英语 regulation。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses keep one motion: measure, correct, hold steady. A rule holds people steady; a governor holds a machine steady; feedback holds a body or a cell steady.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一个动作：测量、纠正、保持稳定。规则让人守稳，调速器让机器稳，反馈让身体或细胞稳。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a governor spinning above an engine and holding the wheel steady.
core.cn: 核心意象：调速器在发动机上方旋转，让轮子保持稳定。

branches.en: RULE AND OVERSIGHT: a single binding rule, then the whole activity of governing an industry.
branches.cn: 规则与监管：一条有约束力的规则，进而治理整个行业的活动。

branches.en: LIFE: feedback loops hold temperature and other variables near a set point.
branches.cn: 生命：反馈环路让体温等变量保持在设定点附近。

branches.en: GENES: expression is switched on, off, or turned up.
branches.cn: 基因：表达被开启、关闭或调高。

branches.en: INNER STATE: a feeling becomes something that can be monitored and adjusted.
branches.cn: 内在状态：情绪变成可被监控与调整的对象。

branches.en: MACHINES AND LAW: valves, match clocks and EU instruments each fix a standard form.
branches.cn: 机器与法律：阀门、比赛计时与欧盟条例各自固定一种标准形式。

intro.en: Regulation is a Latin noun of action in -tio on regulare, whose base regula also gives English rule and regular.
intro.cn: regulation 是加在 regulare 上的拉丁 -tio 动作名词，其词基 regula 也衍生出英语 rule 与 regular。

latinIntro.en: The regula family includes rule, regular, regulate, regulator, regulatory, regime, regiment and region, all turning on the idea of a straight line or a system of order.
latinIntro.cn: regula 词族包括 rule、regular、regulate、regulator、regulatory、regime、regiment、region，核心都围绕直线或秩序体系。

items.meaning: a ruling; the act of keeping steady
items.meaningCN: 规则；使保持稳定的动作
items.example: The regulation covers all large emitters.
items.exampleCN: 该规章覆盖所有大型排放者。

items.meaning: to control by rule or adjust
items.meaningCN: 按规则管理或调节
items.example: The body regulates its own temperature.
items.exampleCN: 身体调节自身温度。

items.meaning: one who or that which regulates
items.meaningCN: 进行调节的人或装置
items.example: The regulator fined the company.
items.exampleCN: 监管机构对公司处以罚款。

items.meaning: relating to regulation
items.meaningCN: 与监管相关的
items.example: Regulatory approval took two years.
items.exampleCN: 监管审批用了两年。

items.meaning: following a fixed pattern
items.meaningCN: 遵循固定模式的
items.example: The train runs on a regular schedule.
items.exampleCN: 火车按固定时刻表运行。

items.meaning: a stated instruction
items.meaningCN: 明确的指示
items.example: The first rule is to sign in.
items.exampleCN: 第一条规则是先签到。

items.meaning: the removal of rules
items.meaningCN: 取消规则
items.example: Deregulation lowered prices but raised risks.
items.exampleCN: 放松管制降低了价格，却提高了风险。

items.meaning: a system of rule or a regimen
items.meaningCN: 统治体系或生活方案
items.example: The new regime tightened border checks.
items.exampleCN: 新政权加强了边境检查。

definition_zh: 加固；加强；增援；强化；使更牢固
definition_en: to make something stronger by adding material, support, or people, or to strengthen an idea or habit by repeating it
core_image: 往旧墙里再灌一根钢筋：老墙照旧立着，只是从今往后更不容易倒
scene: 台风季来临前，工人们给阳台的护栏焊上了新的钢条。The workers reinforced the railing with extra steel bars.
sceneCN: 这里 reinforce 是「加固」（第 1 个义项：增加材料使更牢固）；句意：工人们用额外的钢条加固了护栏。场景要点：台风前的阳台、焊枪的火花、新焊的钢条。

pos.zh: 加固；加强；增援；强化

derivatives.zh: 由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「加固；增援；强化（训练用语）」
由过去分词转形容词，义为「加固过的；增强的」
由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「强化物」（行为科学用语）
同根名词，义为「力；力量；部队」（reinforce 的后半部分）

senses.title: Make a structure physically stronger
senses.definition: to add steel, timber, or other material to a building, wall, or vehicle so that it can carry more or resist damage
senses.definitionCN: 给建筑、墙体或车辆添加钢筋、木料等材料，使其承重更大或更抗损
senses.example: The workers reinforced the railing with extra steel bars.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们用额外的钢条加固了护栏。
senses.why: The word is literally 'to pour force into again': strength is treated like a substance that can be added to what already stands.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的字面是「把力量再次注入」：力量被当作可以往既有之物上添加的材料。

senses.title: Send extra soldiers or equipment
senses.definition: to send additional troops, ships, or supplies to a place under attack or under pressure
senses.definitionCN: 向受攻击或承压之处增派部队、舰船或补给
senses.example: Two divisions were sent to reinforce the northern front.
senses.exampleCN: 两个师被派去增援北方战线。
senses.why: The old military sense keeps the pouring image: extra force is poured into the thinning line of defenders.
senses.whyCN: 古老的军事义保留倾注图景：把额外的力量倾注进日渐稀薄的防线。

senses.title: Make an idea, argument, or belief stronger
senses.definition: to make an argument, impression, or belief stronger by adding support, facts, or repetition
senses.definitionCN: 通过补充论据、事实或重复，使论证、印象或信念更有力
senses.example: The latest data reinforces the case for earlier screening.
senses.exampleCN: 最新数据强化了提前筛查的主张。
senses.why: Arguments are treated like walls: each new fact is another bar poured into the same structure.
senses.whyCN: 论证被当作墙来对待：每一条新事实都是灌进同一结构的又一根钢筋。

senses.title: Strengthen a habit by repeating it
senses.definition: to make a pattern of behaviour more likely to happen again, especially by rewarding it
senses.definitionCN: 通过奖励等方式，使某种行为模式更有可能再次发生
senses.example: Praising children promptly reinforces their good habits.
senses.exampleCN: 及时表扬能强化孩子的好习惯。
senses.why: Psychology borrows the builder's verb: each reward is poured into the habit's wall, so it stands a little higher.
senses.whyCN: 心理学借来建筑动词：每一次奖励都灌进习惯之墙，使它又高了一分。

senses.title: Confirm what already exists
senses.definition: to make an existing impression or attitude firmer, often without intending to, as in reinforce stereotypes
senses.definitionCN: 使已有的印象或态度更顽固，常非有意为之，如 reinforce stereotypes
senses.example: Comedies that joke the same way reinforce old stereotypes about the region.
senses.exampleCN: 以同样方式开玩笑的喜剧加深了关于该地区的旧成见。
senses.why: The wall grows even when no one means to build: repeated contact pours in another layer, and the prejudice hardens.
senses.whyCN: 即便无人有意砌墙，墙也会长高：重复的接触又灌进一层，偏见随之凝固。

intro.en: Reinforce comes from Old French renforcier 'to strengthen again', from re- 'again' + enforcier 'to strengthen', from en- 'in' + force, from Latin fortia, the neuter plural of fortis 'strong'. The earliest English uses are military: to reinforce was to pour more men into a battle.
intro.cn: reinforce 来自古法语 renforcier「再度加强」，由 re-「再」加 enforcier「加强」构成，enforcier 出自 en-「在……里」加 force，force 上溯拉丁语 fortia（fortis「强壮的」的中性复数）。最早的英语用法是军事的：reinforce 即向战场再投入兵力。

items.en: The reconstructed root *dʰerǵʰ- or *bʰerǵʰ- 'to be strong, hold high' underlies Latin fortis and its family fort, fortify, comfort, effort.
items.cn: 一般认为重构词根「强壮、高举」生成了拉丁语 fortis 及其家族 fort、fortify、comfort、effort。

items.en: Fortis meant 'strong, brave'; its neuter plural fortia, 'strengths', passed into Vulgar Latin as a feminine noun forza, the source of French force.
items.cn: fortis 意为「强壮的、勇敢的」；其中性复数 fortia（诸般力量）在通俗拉丁语中转为阴性名词 forza，即法语 force 的来源。

items.en: Enforcier meant 'to strengthen, implant force into'; renforcier added the prefix re- 'again'. Force itself entered English in the thirteenth century.
items.cn: enforcier 意为「加强、把力量注入其中」；renforcier 再添前缀 re-「再」。force 本身在十三世纪进入英语。

items.en: Reinforce appears in English in the fifteenth century, chiefly military: to reinforce a garrison is to send fresh men into it.
items.cn: reinforce 于十五世纪进入英语，主要用于军事：reinforce 一支驻军即向其增派新兵。

items.en: The building sense grows with reinforced concrete in the nineteenth century, and psychology adopts reinforcement in the twentieth for reward-shaped habits.
items.cn: 建筑义随十九世纪的钢筋混凝土成长；二十世纪心理学采用 reinforcement 指奖励塑造的习惯。

note.en: The first group gathers the fortis 'strong' family with its prefixes. The second group compares the verbs of making something stronger or firmer.
note.cn: 第一组汇集 fortis「强壮」词族及其各前缀。第二组比较「使更强、更稳」的动词。

entries.definition: the act of reinforcing, the extra material or troops sent, or the psychology term for reward.
entries.definitionCN: 加固行为、增派的兵力或材料，或心理学的「强化」。

entries.definition: strength, power, or a body of troops. It is the thing poured in by reinforce.
entries.definitionCN: 力；力量；部队。是 reinforce 所倾注之物。

entries.definition: to build strength in, especially walls and defences. It builds from scratch; reinforce adds to what stands.
entries.definitionCN: 设防；筑垒，尤指城墙防线。fortify 从头建强；reinforce 在既有之物上加固。

entries.definition: a fortified place, a stronghold. The strength turned into architecture.
entries.definitionCN: 要塞；堡垒。被凝固为建筑的力量。

entries.definition: an older spelling of reinforce, now rare; both forms meant the same pour of strength.
entries.definitionCN: reinforce 的旧式拼法，今已罕用；两形同义。
