entries.definition: to make strong or stronger in any way. It is the general verb; reinforce implies adding something on top.
entries.definitionCN: 以任何方式使变强。是泛用动词；reinforce 隐含「在原有之上增添」。

entries.definition: to prop something weakening with supports. It props what is failing; reinforce prevents failure.
entries.definitionCN: 用支撑物顶住将倾之物。shore up 挽救衰败；reinforce 防患于未然。

entries.definition: to make firmer by combining or binding together. It joins parts; reinforce adds strength.
entries.definitionCN: 通过合并、凝聚使之稳固。consolidate 联结部分；reinforce 增添强度。

entries.definition: to support with a buttress, hence to back up an argument. It names the prop; reinforce names the pour.
entries.definitionCN: 以扶壁支撑，引申为支持论点。buttress 命名支撑物；reinforce 命名倾注。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: re- 'again' + en- 'in' + force 'strength', the family fortify, fortress, fort and effort, and the pouring-strength-into-a-wall picture.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与真实同族词：re-「再」+ en-「入」+ force「力」，词族 fortify、fortress、fort、effort，以及「往墙里灌注力量」的图景。

normal.en: The word is three real parts: re- again, en- into, force strength.
normal.cn: 这个词由三个真实部分构成：re-「再」、en-「入」、force「力」。

normal.en: Force came from Latin fortis, strong, the same root as fort, the stronghold.
normal.cn: force 出自拉丁语 fortis「强壮」，与 fort「要塞」同根。

normal.en: To reinforce is to pour strength into something again, as concrete is poured around steel bars.
normal.cn: reinforce 就是把力量再度注入某物，如混凝土浇在钢筋四周。

normal.en: The military sense is the oldest: reinforcements are fresh force poured into a battle.
normal.cn: 军事义最古老：增援就是注入战场的生力军。

normal.en: Habits are walls too: every reward poured in makes the behaviour harder to demolish.
normal.cn: 习惯也是墙：每灌进一次奖励，这个行为就更难拆除。

abstract.en: Picture an old wall with a new steel bar inside it: the wall is the same wall, only braver.
abstract.cn: 想象一面旧墙内多了一根新钢筋：墙还是那面墙，只是更硬气了。

abstract.en: Reinforce never replaces: it adds its weight to whatever already stands.
abstract.cn: reinforce 从不替换：它只是往已有之物上再添一份重量。

abstract.en: A repeated stereotype is a wall built by accident, one routine laugh at a time.
abstract.cn: 被反复强化的成见是一堵无意中砌成的墙，一次日常的笑砌一层。

examples.en: Engineers reinforced the old dam before the rainy season.
examples.cn: 工程师们在雨季前加固了旧堤坝。

examples.en: Her example reinforced my belief in second chances.
examples.cn: 她的经历强化了我对第二次机会的信念。

examples.en: The defenders asked for reinforcements before dawn.
examples.cn: 守军在黎明前请求增援。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「锐因福斯」——锐利的钢筋「因」「福」斯（混凝土）而让墙更牢 → reinforce 加固；强化（只借音，不表词源）

root: 源自古法语 renforcier「再度加强」（re- 再 + enforcier 注入力量），force 上溯拉丁语 fortis「强壮的」，核心是「往既有之物里再灌注一份力量」。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of reinforce, one pour seen in five places: walls, battle lines, arguments, habits, and prejudices nobody meant to build.
sensesIntro.cn: reinforce 的五个义项是同一次「倾注」落在五个地方：墙体、战线、论证、习惯，以及无人有意砌成的偏见。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: strength poured again into something that already stands.
core.cn: 核心意象：把力量再度灌入已经立在那里的东西。

chain: POUR IT INTO THE OLD WALL
SEND FRESH FORCE TO THE LINE
REWARD THE HABIT UNTIL IT HARDENS

branches.en: MATERIALS: steel, concrete and timber poured into the structures we trust.
branches.cn: 材料：钢筋、混凝土与木料灌进我们信任的结构。

branches.en: BATTLE: fresh troops poured into a thinning line, the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 战场：把生力军灌进日渐单薄的防线，最古老的义项。

branches.en: ARGUMENTS: facts poured into a case until it can bear weight.
branches.cn: 论证：把事实灌进一个主张，直到它足以承重。

branches.en: MINDS: rewards and repetitions poured into habits and prejudices alike.
branches.cn: 心智：奖励与重复同样灌进习惯与偏见。

branches.en: ONE METHOD: whether the wall is concrete or behaviour, the pour is the same.
branches.cn: 同一方法：无论墙是混凝土还是行为，倾注的方式都一样。

intro.en: Reinforce stacks three morphemes: re- 'again', en- 'into', and force from Latin fortis 'strong'. The fortis family also gives fortify, fortress, fort, comfort and effort.
intro.cn: reinforce 叠加三个语素：re-「再」、en-「入」、force（出自拉丁语 fortis「强壮的」）。fortis 词族还给出 fortify、fortress、fort、comfort、effort。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is fortis 'strong', whose neuter plural fortia 'strengths' became the noun force in Romance. To reinforce is literally to put strength into again.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语源头是 fortis「强壮的」，其中性复数 fortia「诸般力量」在罗曼语中转为名词 force。reinforce 的字面即「把力量再度放入」。

items.meaning: to pour strength in again; to strengthen
items.meaningCN: 加固；强化（re- 再 + en- 入 + force 力）
items.example: They reinforced the roof beams.
items.exampleCN: 他们加固了屋顶横梁。

items.meaning: the act or result of reinforcing; extra troops; a reward in psychology
items.meaningCN: 加固；增援；（心理学的）强化（-ment 构成名词）
items.example: Positive reinforcement shapes classroom habits.
items.exampleCN: 正向强化塑造课堂习惯。

items.meaning: made stronger by added material
items.meaningCN: 加固过的（-ed 分词作形容词）
items.example: The bridge is built of reinforced concrete.
items.exampleCN: 这座桥由钢筋混凝土建成。

items.structure: Latin fortia (neuter plural of fortis), via French
items.meaning: strength; a body of troops; to compel
items.meaningCN: 力量；部队；强迫（经法语 force）
items.example: The wind reached force nine at sea.
items.exampleCN: 海上风力达到九级。

items.meaning: to make strong; to build defences; to add nutrients
items.meaningCN: 设防；增强（-fy 表示「使成为」）
items.example: The city fortified its walls before winter.
items.exampleCN: 入冬前，城市加固了城墙。

items.meaning: a strongly built place of defence
items.meaningCN: 要塞（-ress 表示场所）
items.example: The fortress guards the mountain pass.
items.exampleCN: 要塞扼守山口。

items.meaning: a small stronghold
items.meaningCN: 堡垒（fortress 的缩略）
items.example: The children built a fort of cushions.
items.exampleCN: 孩子们用垫子搭了个小堡垒。

items.meaning: strength given alongside; consolation
items.meaningCN: 安慰（com- 一起 + fortis 力量，即「并肩给予力量」）
items.example: A hot meal gave her real comfort.
items.exampleCN: 一顿热饭给了她实在的慰藉。

items.meaning: strength put out; a trying
items.meaningCN: 努力（ex- 出 + fortis 力量，即「使出力量」）
items.example: Climbing the slope took real effort.
items.exampleCN: 爬这个坡着实费了力气。

items.meaning: strength of mind under pain
items.meaningCN: 坚毅（-itude 构成性质名词）
items.example: She bore the long illness with fortitude.
items.exampleCN: 她以坚毅承受了漫长的病痛。
